english: Xinchang lies in eastern Zhejiang, among the mountains south of the Shan River. Its great Buddhist temple is built against the cliffs of Shicheng Mountain, where a monumental image of Maitreya was carved in the Southern Dynasties. Work began under the Qi and was completed under the Liang in 516. The image was repaired repeatedly over the centuries, while a bridge built in the Ming approached the cavern before it.
simp_chinese: 新昌位于浙江东部，地处剡溪以南的群山间。石城山上的大佛寺依崖而建，寺中巨大的石弥勒像开凿于南朝齐代，梁代516年完工。此后造像历经多次修缮；明代又在石窟前修建无量桥，连接寺院与佛像。

english:
Xinchang lies among the hills of western Jiangxi. On Dong Mountain north of the county town stands a monastery founded by the Tang monk Liangjie, a source of the Caodong school of Chan Buddhism. Streams and old paths lead through the wooded mountains to the temple, where generations of monks taught and practised.

The monastery was damaged at the end of the Yuan and rebuilt under the Ming. In the Chongzhen reign, the local scholar Dai Guoshi helped restore it and invited the monk Jingcong to become abbot. Monks gathered again from distant places, renewing the community. In 1672, under the Qing, it received the name Puli Temple, by which the mountain monastery became known.
simp_chinese:
新昌位于江西西部丘陵间。县北洞山有唐代良价禅师创建的寺院，是禅宗曹洞宗的祖庭。山溪与古道穿过林木通往寺中，历代僧人在此修行、讲法。

寺院元末受损，明代重建。崇祯年间，地方士人戴国士倡议修复，请僧人净聪主持，四方僧众再次聚集。1672年清代更名普利禅寺，这座山中寺院由此获得后来通行的名称。

english: Xincheng stood on the Lei River between Hengyang and Leiyang. The river carried the Tang poet Du Fu past the settlement in his final years. Under the Ming, Xincheng County was abolished and its territory absorbed into Hengyang in the fourteenth century. The old town survived as a riverside street, later divided between Hengyang and Leiyang; a stone set into the street marked the boundary between the two counties. Its buildings preserved the character of an old southern Hunan market.
simp_chinese: 新城位于衡阳与耒阳之间的耒水沿岸。唐代诗人杜甫晚年曾由水路经过此地。明代十四世纪，新城县被撤销，其地并入衡阳。旧县城仍作为江边街市延续，后来分属衡阳、耒阳两县，街中嵌有石块标示县界，沿街建筑保存着湘南古镇的风貌。

english: Xīnchéng was a Ming military post in the highlands of southwestern Guizhou, in the country around Xīngrén. It was established as a thousand-household post subordinate to Ānnán Guard, one of the garrisons created as the Ming organised its hold over the route to Yunnan. The surrounding region also contained Pǔ'ān Guard and several smaller posts, placing Xīnchéng within a chain of military settlements across the plateau.
simp_chinese: 新城是贵州西南高地的一处明代军屯，位于今兴仁一带。明朝设新城千户所，隶属于安南卫，是王朝经营通往云南道路时建立的驻军据点之一。周围还有普安卫及其他较小军所，新城由此成为高原上卫所网络的一环。

sources.title: 黔西南布依族苗族自治州

english: Xincheng lies on the Hebei plain north of Baoding. In the northeastern part of the old town stands Kaishan Temple, known for its great Buddhist hall. The hall dates from the Liao dynasty and uses a timber frame with relatively few interior columns, leaving an open space around the images within. Other halls were added in the Ming and Qing periods, making the monastery a record of successive generations of builders.
simp_chinese: 新城位于保定以北的河北平原。旧城东北的开善寺以大雄宝殿著称，大殿为辽代木构，内部减省立柱，使佛像周围空间开阔。明清时期又增建其他殿宇，整座寺院记录了历代营造者的技艺。

english: Xincheng stood on the Litan River in eastern Jiangxi, near the mountain routes into Fujian. The Southern Song established the county in 1138 from five districts of Nancheng, making the market town of Litan its seat. It belonged to Jianchang throughout the Yuan, Ming and Qing. The town originally had no walls: earth defences were begun in 1512 and faced with brick and stone two years later. Rain damaged them in 1519, and further repairs followed during the Jiajing reign.
simp_chinese: 新城位于江西东部黎滩河畔，靠近通往福建的山路。南宋于1138年从南城划出五乡设县，以黎滩镇为治所，元、明、清时期均属建昌。县城原无城墙，1512年始筑土垣，两年后包砌砖石；1519年雨水冲毁部分城垣，嘉靖年间又多次修葺。

english: Xincheng is an old county town on the Shandong plain, associated with the scholarly Wang family. Its ancestors settled here in the late Yuan period, and generations of descendants passed the civil examinations and served as officials under the Ming and Qing. Their prominence earned the family the saying that the Wangs filled half the court. One of its best-known members, Wang Shizhen, became a leading Qing poet and rose to minister of justice before retiring to his home town in 1704.
simp_chinese: 新城是山东平原上的古县城，也是书香世家王氏的故里。王氏祖先于元末迁居此地，后代在明清两朝世代登科仕宦，声望之盛，时有“王半朝”之称。其中王士禛是清初著名诗人，官至刑部尚书，1704年告老回到故乡。

english: Xincheng lies among the hills of central Guangxi, where the Mo family held a hereditary native office. In 1582 the chieftain Mo Zhenwei began building a new residence and administrative compound below Cuiping Mountain. The buildings housed the government of the native county as well as the family’s household, giving visible form to an authority that endured from the Ming into the Qing.
simp_chinese: 忻城位于广西中部丘陵之间，莫氏家族在此世袭土官。明万历十年（1582年），土官莫镇威在翠屏山下开始兴建新的衙署。这里既是土县的官署，也是土司家族的居所，见证了莫氏权力从明代延续到清代。

english: Xīndī stands on the northern bank of the Yangtze in the lake country of the Jianghan Plain. Its name, “new dyke,” recalls a long embankment built at Máojiāngkǒu in 1524 after floods had broken the older works. A riverside town grew near the junction of the Yangtze and inland waterways, among fields and lakes exposed to seasonal floods.
simp_chinese: 新堤位于江汉平原湖泊地带的长江北岸。“新堤”之名源于1524年在茅江口修筑的长堤，此前洪水曾冲毁旧堤。江边市镇在长江与内河交汇处发展，周围田湖仍面临季节性水患。

english: Xindu lies north of Chengdu on the fertile plain of western Sichuan. Its Baoguang Temple is a major Buddhist monastery, with halls and a pagoda set among courtyards. Tradition recalls the Tang emperor Xizong taking refuge here during the Huang Chao rebellion and ordering the temple and its pagoda repaired. The monastery preserves inscriptions, scriptures and images from many periods. After the destruction and disorder of the late Ming, the Chan monk Xiaozong Yinmi began rebuilding Baoguang Temple in 1670. Work continued under the Qing, restoring a religious centre that drew monks and worshippers from the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 新都位于成都以北的川西沃野。宝光寺是当地重要的佛教寺院，殿堂和佛塔分布于层层院落间。相传唐僖宗避黄巢之乱入蜀时曾驻跸于此，并命人修葺寺塔。寺中保存着历代碑刻、经卷与造像。明末战乱之后，禅僧笑宗印密于1670年开始重修宝光寺。清代修建工作持续进行，使这座吸引周边僧俗信众的寺院重获生机。

english: Xindu is an old name for the seat of Jizhou on the North China Plain. Rivers crossing the low ground shaped the city's fortunes: an inscription records the Hutuo and Fuyang overflowing together in 1527, their waters spreading eastward into a pool. Jizhou also maintained a tradition of learning. Its Xindu Academy was established in 1576, providing a place for students of the prefecture to pursue their studies.
simp_chinese: 信都是华北平原冀州治所的旧名。河流影响着低地城邑的命运：碑刻记载1527年滹沱河与滏阳河同时泛滥，向东汇成一片水潭。冀州也有读书传统，1576年建成信都书院，为州内士子提供了研习之所。

english: Xinfeng lies in the hills and valleys south of Ganzhou, on a route toward the mountains separating Jiangxi from Guangdong. Above its county town rises the brick pagoda of Dasheng Temple. Built in 1064 under the Northern Song, the six-sided tower has nine storeys and was celebrated for its great height. Its projecting eaves and balconies give the pagoda a slender profile above the surrounding buildings. Under the Ming, the temple bore the name Zhusheng, preserving a Buddhist landmark in the county.
simp_chinese: 信丰位于赣州以南的丘陵河谷间，南面道路通向赣粤交界的山岭。县城大圣寺塔高耸，砖塔六面九层，建于北宋1064年，以高峻闻名。层层飞檐和平座使塔身挺拔于周围建筑之上。明代寺院曾称祝圣寺，这座佛塔长期是县中的地标。

english: Xinfeng lies among the hills of northern Guangdong, near the headwaters of the Xinfeng River. In 1569 the Ming established Changning County from parts of Heyuan, Yingde and Wengyuan, giving it a name expressing a hope for lasting peace. Four years later the county seat moved beneath Junzizhang Mountain, where a brick town was built. Its rivers flow towards the Dong River and the Pearl River system.
simp_chinese: 新丰位于广东北部丘陵间，靠近新丰江源头。1569年，明朝从河源、英德、翁源划地设置长宁县，以“长久安宁”为名。四年后，县治迁至君子嶂下，筑起砖城。当地河水流向东江，属于珠江水系。

english: Xing'an occupies the corridor between the Xiang and Li river systems. Here the Ling Canal, dug under the Qin, joined waterways leading to the Yangtze and the Pearl River. Its channels carried soldiers, grain and other traffic across the mountainous divide between Hunan and Guangxi. The canal required repeated care. In 1371 the Ming repaired its thirty-six water-control gates and faced them with stone. Another undertaking in 1396 dredged the channel, raised embankments and removed rocks that obstructed boats, restoring a route for the transport of grain. Repairs followed in later reigns, including a major restoration in 1602.
simp_chinese: 兴安位于湘江与漓江水系之间的通道上。秦代开凿的灵渠在这里沟通通往长江与珠江的水路，使军队、粮食和船货能够越过湖南、广西之间的山地分水岭。 灵渠历来需要不断修治。1371年，明朝修整三十六处陡门，以石砌筑；1396年又疏浚渠道、加高堤坝，并凿去阻碍行舟的石头，恢复漕运。此后各朝继续修渠，1602年又进行了一次大规模修复。

english: Xīngàn is one of the eighteen ancient counties of Jiāngxī, set up in 221 BCE on the middle reaches of the Gàn River. Its seat moved once under the Suí, to the village of Nánshì. In 627 it was the seat of an inspector of five prefectures including Qián and Jí, and under the Míng it belonged to Línjiāng Prefecture, on the river road between Nánchāng and Jí'ān.
simp_chinese: 新淦是江西十八古县之一，前221年置县，位于赣江中游。隋代县治迁到南市村。627年，新淦是虔、吉等五州巡抚使的驻地。明代新淦属临江府，位于南昌与吉安之间的赣江通道上。

english: Xīngguó lies in the hills of south-central Jiāngxī, a Hakka county in the northern part of Gànzhōu. It was set up in 982 from lands of three neighboring counties, and takes its name from the era Tàipíng Xīngguó of the reigning Sòng emperor; later dynasties kept the name.
simp_chinese: 兴国位于江西中南部的丘陵地带，是赣州北部的客家聚居县。982年自邻近三县之地析置，以当时宋朝的年号“太平兴国”为县名，后世沿用未改。

english: Xīnghuà lies among the lakes and marshes of the Lǐxiàhé lowlands between the Yangtze and Huái rivers. Farmers raised strips of land above the water, creating fields separated by channels. These raised plots took shape in the early Míng period and spread as the wetlands changed, producing a distinctive landscape of cultivated ground and waterways.
simp_chinese: 兴化位于江淮之间里下河低地的湖泊与沼泽之中。农人将地块垒高，使田地露出水面，其间以水道相隔。这些垛田在明初出现，随着湿地变化而发展，形成了田地与水道交错的景观。

english: Xinghua Bay opens southeastward from the coast of Fujian toward the Taiwan Strait. The Mulan and other streams flow into its waters, while islands and narrow channels guard the entrance. Low hills and plains surround the bay, and broad tidal flats extend along its shores, where land and sea meet across a gently sloping coast.
simp_chinese: 兴化湾从福建海岸向东南敞开，通往台湾海峡。木兰溪等河流注入湾中，岛屿和狭长水道环绕湾口。低山丘陵与平原围绕海湾，宽广的潮滩沿岸展开，陆地在平缓的海岸与海水相接。

english: Xingning lies in the inland valleys of eastern Guangdong. Its county school and Confucian temple served both education and ceremonial worship, giving local students a place to study the classics and prepare for examinations. A temple to Confucius was first established here during the Southern Song; under the Ming and Qing the school and temple formed the principal institutions of official learning in the county town.
simp_chinese: 兴宁位于广东东部内陆河谷。县学与文庙兼具教育和祭祀用途，为当地士子研读经书、准备科举提供场所。南宋嘉定年间，兴宁已建孔庙；明清时期，县学和文庙共同构成县城官办教育的重要场所。

english: Xīngshān lies in a mountain valley by the Xiāng Stream, north of the Yangtze gorges. It is traditionally celebrated as the home of Wáng Zhāojūn, the Hàn court woman sent to marry the Xiongnu ruler. A shrine known as Zhāojūn’s temple was rebuilt in 1415 under the Míng, preserving her memory beside the stream.
simp_chinese: 兴山位于长江峡谷以北的香溪山谷，历来被视为王昭君的故乡。汉代昭君远嫁匈奴，此后家乡为她兴建纪念祠院。明永乐十三年（1415年）重修昭君院，使她的故事继续留在香溪之畔。

english:
Xíngtái stands on the plain below the eastern slopes of the Taihang Mountains. Xingzhou here was the home of Liu Bingzhong, the monk and adviser who helped plan Khubilai Khan's capitals, and of Guo Shoujing, the astronomer and hydraulic engineer. In 1262 Khubilai raised the department to Shunde Prefecture, which became a circuit in 1265. Guo served the Khan in hydraulic works and prepared the Shoushi calendar, completed in 1280. The Ming adopted it, with little change, as their Datong calendar.

In 1368 the Ming restored Shunde Prefecture, ruling nine counties directly from the capital region. The Kaiyuan Temple, founded under the Tang, had been a royal temple of the Yuan. In the late 1460s the prefecture rebuilt the Qingfeng Pavilion southeast of its offices, a double-eaved hip-and-gable hall in Ming style.
simp_chinese:
邢台坐落在太行山东麓的平原上。邢州是元世祖忽必烈的谋臣、僧人刘秉忠的故乡，也是天文学家、水利专家郭守敬的故乡。1262年，忽必烈将邢州升为顺德府，1265年改为顺德路。郭守敬为元世祖主持水利工程，并主持编订了1280年完成的《授时历》，明朝几乎原样沿用，称为《大统历》。

1368年，明朝复设顺德府，直属京师，辖九县。始建于唐代的开元寺在元代曾是皇家寺院。15世纪60年代末，顺德府重建府衙东南的清风楼，楼为重檐歇山式，保持着明代的风格。

english: Xingtang lies where the North China Plain meets the eastern foothills of the Taihang Mountains. Cultivated lowlands and hills offered different resources, and roads connected the district with towns in central Hebei and with routes into the uplands. Farming depended on rain and water management, while county institutions linked households with taxation and official administration, and temples, schools and lineages shaped local society.
simp_chinese: 行唐位于华北平原与太行山东麓相接处。耕作低地与丘陵提供不同资源，道路连接河北中部城镇及通往山地的路线。农业依靠降雨和水源管理，县级机构将居民与赋税和行政联系起来，庙宇、学校及宗族也影响地方生活。

english: The forests of the Xingu basin stretch across a network of tributaries south of the Amazon. The Xingu itself rises on the Brazilian plateau and runs north to join the great river, passing through rapids as well as stretches navigable by canoe. Dense tropical forest covers much of its lower basin, a homeland of numerous Indigenous peoples whose languages and histories differ across the watershed.
simp_chinese: 欣古河流域的森林覆盖亚马孙河南方众多支流之间的土地。欣古河发源于巴西高原，向北流入亚马孙河，途中既有急流，也有独木舟能够通行的河段。茂密的热带森林覆盖了下游流域的大部分地区；不同语言和历史的众多原住民族世代生活在这片流域中。

english: Xing County lies among the loess hills of western Shanxi, where the Lanyi River runs towards the Yellow River. At Heiyukou, a ferry and landing connected Shanxi with Shaanxi across the water. During the Ming and Qing, it became a busy meeting place for merchants and goods moving by river and land. The early Ming reduced the former Xingzhou to a county in 1369 and later placed it under Kelan department.
simp_chinese: 兴县位于晋西黄土丘陵中，岚漪河从此流向黄河。黄河岸边的黑峪口是水陆码头和渡口，连接山西与对岸陕西。明清时期，货物经水路、陆路在此集散，商贾云集。明初于1369年将兴州降为县，后改属岢岚州。

english: Xingyang lies west of Zhengzhou, where the approaches from Luoyang meet the Yellow River plain. The region includes the old Hulao Pass and the Guangwu hills, long contested by armies moving between the east and west. Qin rulers stored grain at Aocang, while Liu Bang and Xiang Yu struggled for control of the area during the wars that founded the Han. In 1635 leaders of several anti-Ming armies gathered at Dahai Temple near Xingyang and agreed to divide their forces for campaigns in different directions.
simp_chinese: 荥阳位于郑州以西，洛阳通向黄河平原的道路在此经过。虎牢关与广武山一带自古是东西军旅争夺的要地：秦朝在敖仓储粮，楚汉相争时刘邦与项羽也曾在附近对峙。1635年，反明各路义军首领在荥阳大海寺会聚，商议分兵向不同方向进军。

english: Xingzhong, on the Daling River, was an important centre of western Liaoning under the Liao and Jin. Its Buddhist pagodas rose above a town whose history reached back to the capitals of the Yan states. The North Pagoda incorporated earlier structures beneath its Liao exterior, while other towers gave the settlement the name Three Pagodas in later times. The Yuan reduced Xingzhong from a superior prefecture to a prefecture, and the Ming established military guards there. Under the Qing, Three Pagodas became an administrative centre again: a subprefecture was established in 1774 and replaced by Chaoyang County in 1778. The old towers endured through these changes of government.
simp_chinese: 兴中位于大凌河畔，是辽金时期辽西的重要中心。城中佛塔高耸，而这座聚落的历史可追溯到燕国都城。北塔辽代外层包裹着更早的建筑遗存；连同其他佛塔，后世称这一带为三座塔。 元代兴中府降为州，明代在此设置军事卫所。清代三座塔再次成为行政中心：1774年设厅，1778年改设朝阳县。历经政权和建置的变化，古塔依旧矗立。

english:
Xingzi stands between Lake Poyang and the southern slopes of Mount Lu, the seat of historic Nankang. Beneath the Five Old Men Peaks lies White Deer Grotto Academy, a celebrated place of learning amid streams and wooded hills. Its name recalls a Tang scholar said to have kept a white deer while studying in the mountains.

In 1179 the Song philosopher Zhu Xi became governor of Nankang and set about restoring the academy. He taught there and established rules for study and conduct that influenced academies across China. The buildings were repaired repeatedly during the Ming and Qing, and students travelled from distant provinces to attend lectures, keeping the mountain retreat connected to a much wider scholarly world.
simp_chinese:
星子位于鄱阳湖与庐山南麓之间，是历史上南康府的治所。五老峰下溪流环绕、林木幽深，有著名的白鹿洞书院。其名源于唐代读书人山中养白鹿的传说。

1179年，朱熹出知南康，着手兴复书院，在此讲学并制定学规，对后世书院产生深远影响。明清时期书院屡经修葺，远方学子前来求学，使这处山中书院与更广的学术世界相连。

english:
Xinhua belongs to the hill and river country of central Hunan, where cultivated valleys, woodland, and routes along the Zi River connect local communities. Rice and other crops support households on suitable ground, while forest products, crafts, and exchange add to livelihoods. The varied terrain creates practical differences between neighboring places and encourages movement along particular river and overland corridors.

The area was historically associated with Meishan. In 1072, under the Northern Song, the upper part of Meishan was organised as Xinhua County while the lower part became Anhua. The county's later history combined local traditions and agricultural communities with the institutions of successive dynasties; the Zi River provided a route through the hilly interior.
simp_chinese:
新化属于湖南中部丘陵河流地区，耕谷、林地和资江沿线道路联系社群。稻米等作物在适地支持家庭，林产、工艺和交换丰富生计。多样地形使邻地条件不同，移动集中具体水陆走廊。居民通过地方经验管理资源，也需要跨环境交换获得补充，河流交通为区域经济重要基础。

这一地区历史上与梅山有关。北宋熙宁五年（1072年），上梅山置新化县，下梅山置安化县。此后地方传统和农业社群与历代行政机构并存，资江则为丘陵内陆提供通行路线。

english: Xīnhuà lies among the deep valleys and forests of western Húběi, north of the Yangtze gorges. The wider mountain country was divided between Fáng, Xīngshān, and Bādōng in earlier times. During the Qīng, the wooded ridges offered refuge to armed groups, including forces associated with the White Lotus uprisings.
simp_chinese: 新化位于湖北西部的深谷密林之中，长江峡谷以北。历史上，周围山区分属房县、兴山和巴东。清代林木茂密的山岭曾为武装队伍提供藏身之处，其中包括白莲教起义军。

english: Xinhui lies among the waterways of the western Pearl River Delta. It was the home of Chen Xianzhang, the Ming scholar whose teaching at Baisha made the district a center of learning. Known as Master Baisha, Chen emphasized quiet reflection and the cultivation of the mind. After his death in 1500, his reputation drew students and admirers to his native place. A shrine honoring him was built in 1584, preserving his memory in the district where he had taught.
simp_chinese: 新会位于珠江三角洲西部的水乡，是明代学者陈献章的故乡。他在白沙讲学，使这里成为岭南的一处学术中心。陈献章世称白沙先生，重视静坐体悟和心性的修养。1500年他去世后，声名仍吸引着求学者和仰慕者前来。1584年，乡人为纪念他修建祠堂，使他的学术遗泽留在这片曾经讲学的地方。

english: Xinhure stands in the grasslands north of the Hetao plain, near a pass through the Lang Mountains. Here stood the seat of the Yuan circuit of Wulahai, whose jurisdiction extended across the Yinshan and Hetao country. Traces of buildings and decorated roof tiles recall a settled administrative centre amid a landscape otherwise associated with pastoral life and routes through the mountains.
simp_chinese: 新忽热位于河套平原以北的草原，靠近狼山山口。这里曾是元代兀剌海路的治所，辖境包括阴山和河套一带。房址与装饰瓦当留下了这座行政城址的痕迹；城外则是牧地和穿越山岭的道路。

english:
Xining stands in the valley of the Huang River, at the eastern gateway to the Tibetan Plateau. Roads from Gansu converge here before climbing toward the high pastures and the country around Qinghai Lake. The town brought together merchants and communities of different languages and faiths, including Han, Hui, Tibetan and Mongol peoples. Its position between farming valleys and pastoral highlands made it a natural place for trade as well as a frontier stronghold.

The Ming established a garrison at Xining and strengthened its walls. In 1397 the tea and horse office was moved here from Qinzhou, placing an important exchange with the peoples of the borderlands under official supervision. Tea from the interior was exchanged for horses, and trade helped connect the town with communities across the plateau. South of Xining, a shrine at the birthplace of Tsongkhapa, founder of the Gelug school, grew into Kumbum Monastery; a Maitreya hall was built there in 1577.

In the early eighteenth century the Qing faced a revolt led by the Mongol prince Lobzang Danjin in the Qinghai region. After suppressing it, the court reorganised the administration around Xining, replacing the military garrison with a prefecture and appointing officials to manage affairs in the surrounding lands. Xining remained a meeting point for soldiers, traders and pilgrims travelling between Gansu and the plateau.
simp_chinese:
西宁位于湟水河谷，是通往青藏高原东部的门户。甘肃方向的道路在此汇集，再向高原牧场和青海湖一带攀升。汉、回、藏、蒙古等不同语言与信仰的社群在这里往来，农耕河谷与高原牧区交会的位置，使它既是边防要地，也是贸易中心。

明朝在西宁设卫并加强城防。1397年，茶马司从秦州迁来，朝廷在此管理与边地诸族的交易，以内地茶叶交换马匹。贸易将城镇与高原各地连接起来。西宁以南，格鲁派创始人宗喀巴诞生地的纪念塔逐渐发展为塔尔寺，1577年修建了弥勒殿。

十八世纪初，青海蒙古亲王罗卜藏丹津起兵反清。清朝平定后调整西宁周边的行政，将卫所改为府，并派官员管理周围地域。此后，西宁仍是士兵、商人与朝圣者往来甘肃和高原的汇集之地。

english:
Xinjian lies west of the Gan River around Nanchang. In the Western Hills stands Wanshou Palace, a Daoist sanctuary dedicated to Xu Xun, revered as a protector and immortal. The palace became a centre of the Jingming tradition, which taught loyalty and filial devotion alongside religious practice.

The Song court rebuilt the sanctuary on a grand scale, with halls, gates and galleries spread across the hillside. It was repaired again under the Ming and enlarged under the Qing. By the later Ming the palace had become a focus of local worship, drawing communities to its festivals. Devotion to Xu Xun travelled with Jiangxi merchants, giving the Western Hills a place in a network of temples far beyond the province.
simp_chinese:
新建位于赣江西岸、南昌周围。西山万寿宫奉祀许逊，信众尊其为护佑乡里的仙真。这里也是净明道的重要中心，忠孝与修道共同构成其信仰传统。

宋廷曾大规模重建宫观，山间殿阁、廊庑与门楼相连。明代又有修葺，清代增建建筑。至明代后期，万寿宫已成为地方祭祀中心，乡民前来参加庙会。许逊信仰随江西商人传播，使西山与省外众多宫庙相联系。

english: Xinkai belongs to the river country north of the West Liao. The waterway known historically as Taigen Gol crosses the western plain, where grassland, river channels and low sandy ground meet. In the Qing period Mongol banners shared this wider country, and boundaries between their pastures were described by reference to rivers, hills and other landmarks. The old channels and seasonal waters gave shape to a plain traversed by herders and their animals.
simp_chinese: 新开属于西辽河以北的河流地区。这条水道旧称台根郭勒，流经西部平原，草地、河道和低矮沙地在此相接。清代蒙古各旗分处这一广大地区，牧地界限常以河流、山丘等地标为依据。旧河道与季节水流塑造了牧人及牲畜往来的平原。

english: Xinle lies on the North China Plain, north of the Hutuo River. At Fuxi Terrace, a temple honours Fuxi, the legendary ancestral ruler associated with the origins of Chinese civilisation. The site preserves traces of settlement from the Shang, Zhou, and Han periods, while the sanctuary was repaired and enlarged over successive dynasties. Its worship connected the local landscape with stories of the most distant beginnings of human society.
simp_chinese: 新乐位于华北平原，滹沱河以北。当地伏羲台上有庙供奉传说中的人文始祖伏羲，台地及周边留有商、周、汉时期的遗存。庙宇历代经过增建修葺，使地方景观与关于人类社会远古起源的传说联系在一起。

english:
Xingning stood among the mountains and valleys east of Chenzhou, in the upper basin of the river that joins the Chen and flows toward the Lei. Its old county gazetteer describes lofty hills, fertile ground and turbulent rapids, where boats could pass only with difficulty. The county seat lay at the place later known as Xingning town, south of the older Zixing seat.

The district's administrative history was marked by changes of name and jurisdiction. The gazetteer recalls periods when its territory was absorbed into Chen County and others when it belonged to Guiyang. The name Xingning endured through the Ming and Qing, preserving a distinct county among the mountains of southeastern Hunan.
simp_chinese:
兴宁位于郴州以东的群山河谷间，水流与郴水会合后通向耒水。旧县志形容此地山高谷深、土地肥沃，却也滩险水急，舟楫难行。县治在后来称作兴宁镇的地方，位于更古老的资兴旧治以南。

这一带的建置与隶属屡经变化：县志记载，其地有时并入郴县，有时属桂阳。明清时期，兴宁仍以县名延续，成为湘东南群山中一处独立的县治。

english: Xinning lies east of Dazhou, at the southern foot of the Daba Mountains. Its lowlands and surrounding hills form part of the eastern Sichuan Basin, a country of fields and streams between the mountain ridges. The county was established in the sixth century, abolished under the Sui and restored under the Tang. It remained known as Xinning through the Ming and Qing periods.
simp_chinese: 新宁位于达州以东、大巴山南麓。县境的低地与周围丘陵属于四川盆地东部，田野和溪流分布在山岭之间。此地六世纪设县，隋代废入石城县，唐代复置新宁县；明清时期仍沿用新宁之名。

english: Xinning lies in the mountain country south of Wugang, along the Fuyi River. Its county gazetteers preserve a record of the ferries that carried people across the water. The earliest surviving gazetteer, printed in 1606, listed three crossings, while the 1823 edition recorded thirty-six along the river. At one old ferry, a field belonging to a local lineage supplied the ferryman's provisions. Xinning was one of the counties administered from Wugang after that district was raised to military prefecture in the Song.
simp_chinese: 新宁位于武冈以南的山地，夫夷江流经县境。历代县志留下了江上渡口的记录：现存最早、1606年刊行的县志列出三处渡口，1823年的版本则记载了沿江三十六处。一处古渡旁，地方宗族以田地出产供养渡工。宋代武冈升为军后，新宁是其所辖诸县之一。

english:
Xinping stands in the middle Jing River valley, in the uplands north of the Wei plain. The town served as the seat of Binzhou for centuries and lay on a route between the Guanzhong heartland and the Gansu frontier. Its county name dates to the Sui, when Baitu County was moved here and renamed Xinping. The surrounding region was associated with the early history of the Zhou people.

Under the Tang the prefecture came to be known as Binzhou, with its seat at Xinping. The city retained that role through the Song and Yuan. Early in the Ming, Xinping County was absorbed into the prefecture itself, which was placed under Xi'an; the walls and offices of the old county town remained the centre from which the prefecture was administered.
simp_chinese:
新平位于泾河中游、渭北高原一带，长期为邠州治所，地处关中与甘肃之间的通道。隋朝将白土县迁至此地后改名新平，县名由此而来。周围地区也与周人早期历史相联系。

唐代此州改称邠州，治所在新平；宋、元时期城池仍为州治。明初，新平县并入州署，邠州隶属西安府。旧县城的城垣与官署仍是地方行政中心。

english: Xintai lies southeast of Mount Tai, near the wooded ridges of Xinfu Mountain, also known as Lotus Mountain. Local tradition held that Emperor Wu of Han built a palace on its southern slope. The county gazetteer tells another story of two ancient scholar trees in the county office: when Xintai was absorbed into Laiwu under the Yuan, the trees withered, only to revive when the county was restored. The inhabitants came to regard them as trees of unusual spirit.
simp_chinese: 新泰位于泰山东南，附近是层峦苍翠的新甫山，又称莲花山。传说汉武帝曾在山南建离宫。县志还记载了县署内两株古槐的故事：元代新泰并入莱芜时，槐树随之枯萎；及至复县，树又重新繁茂，当地人遂称之为灵槐。

english: Xintian lies east of Guizhou city on the road through the plateau toward Huguang. The Yuan established a native administration here in 1291; the Ming later placed a garrison at the town, making it Xintian Guard in 1390. Soldiers cultivated military fields around the fort, while the guard oversaw several hereditary local offices. In the early seventeenth century government troops set out from Xintian to relieve the siege of Guizhou city. The Qing abolished the guard in 1687 and moved the seat of Guiding County into its town.
simp_chinese: 新添位于贵州城以东，是穿越高原通往湖广道路上的要地。元朝于1291年设新添葛蛮安抚司，明代在镇中驻军，1390年升为新添卫。军士在卫城周围屯田，卫所还管辖多个世袭长官司。十七世纪初，官军曾从新添出发，解贵州城之围。1687年清朝裁撤新添卫，将贵定县治迁入卫城。

english: Xinxiang lies on the plain below the Taihang Mountains, near routes linking the Yellow River with the north. In the Ming, the Prince of Lu held an estate in this region. His tomb and that of his consort were built at the foot of Fenghuang Mountain, with a sequence of stone gates, halls and burial chambers. In 1656 a Buddhist monk acquired the complex and adapted its buildings for religious use.
simp_chinese: 新乡位于太行山下的平原，附近道路连接黄河与北方。明代潞王在这一地区拥有封地，他与妃子的陵墓建在凤凰山南麓，石门、殿宇与地宫依次排列。1656年，一位僧人购得陵园，将建筑改为佛殿和庵堂。

english: Xinxing occupies a basin on the central Yunnan plateau, surrounded by hills and linked to the roads leading toward Kunming and the south. Its history as an administrative settlement reaches back to the Yuan dynasty, when a military colony was established here in 1293. The Ming and Qing retained Xinxing as a county, giving the basin a continuing place in the government of the surrounding countryside. Fields in the basin and settlements on its margins formed the setting for this long-lived local centre.
simp_chinese: 新兴坐落于滇中高原的一处盆地，四周环山，道路通向昆明和南方。元代于1293年在此设立军民屯，地方建置由此发展。明清两代沿置新兴县，使这座盆地中心长期承担周围乡土的行政事务。盆地中的田地与边缘的村落，共同构成了它的地方景观。

english: Xīnxīng was a Ming thousand-household post in the southwestern Guizhou highlands, at Pǔ'ān. It belonged to Ānnán Guard, whose garrisons formed part of the military presence along the route to Yunnan. The area also contained the separate Pǔ'ān Guard, as well as other military posts. Their settlements placed soldiers and their households among the older communities of the plateau as the Ming consolidated its rule in the southwest.
simp_chinese: 新兴所位于贵州西南高地，即今普安一带。明朝在此设置新兴千户所，隶属安南卫，是通往云南道路沿线驻军的一部分。同一地区还有普安卫及其他军所，随着明朝巩固西南统治，军士及其家属在高原原有的居民社群之间定居下来。

sources.title: 黔西南布依族苗族自治州

english: Xinxing is the birthplace of Huineng, revered as the Sixth Patriarch of Chan Buddhism. At Longshan, Guo'en Temple is associated with his final years and death in 713. His teachings and the stories told about him spread far beyond his native district. The temple was repaired in 1408 under the Ming, but later fell into decline. A major rebuilding began in 1448, providing halls for Buddhist worship and the patriarch, with quarters for monks at either side. The work helped revive a religious centre closely tied to the memory of Huineng.
simp_chinese: 新兴是禅宗六祖惠能的出生地。龙山国恩寺与他晚年生活及713年圆寂的故事相联系，他的教导和传说远播故乡之外。 国恩寺于明代1408年修缮，后来逐渐衰落。1448年，寺院开始大修，建起供奉佛祖和六祖的殿堂，两侧设僧房，使这座与惠能密切相关的寺院重新兴盛。

english:
Xinyang stands at the meeting of the southern Henan plain and the wooded hills bordering the upper Huai basin. Once called Yiyang, it was the seat of Shenzhou under the Tang and later received the name Xinyang. The area's mountains have long produced tea: the Tang writer Lu Yu listed Yiyang among the tea-growing districts of Huainan in his Classic of Tea.

Under the Ming and Qing, Xinyang was a prefectural centre within the wider Runing administration. Its position near the passes through the southern mountains placed it on routes between Henan and the lands of the middle Yangtze. Warfare at the end of the Ming and migration under the Qing altered the population of the region; families from Jiangxi and other southern provinces came to settle in the countryside around Xinyang.
simp_chinese:
信阳位于豫南平原与淮河上游林木葱郁的丘陵交接处。这里旧称义阳，唐代为申州治所，后来改名信阳。山地历来出产茶叶，唐代陆羽在《茶经》中便将义阳列入淮南茶区。

明清时期，信阳是汝宁所辖的州治。城市靠近南方山间关隘，河南与长江中游之间的道路由此经过。明末战乱和清代人口迁徙改变了这一地区的人口面貌，来自江西等南方省份的家庭在信阳周边乡间定居下来。

english: Xinye lies in the Nanyang basin, between the northern plain and the routes south towards Xiangyang. At the end of the Han, Liu Bei stationed his forces here while contending with rival commanders. Local tradition remembers a terrace where he consulted Zhuge Liang and his companions. The town and its surrounding fields became part of the stories of the Three Kingdoms, retold long after the armies had passed.
simp_chinese: 新野位于南阳盆地，地处北方平原与南下襄阳的道路之间。东汉末年，刘备曾驻军新野，与各方争夺天下。当地传说有议事台，纪念他同诸葛亮等人商议军务；军队远去后，新野及周围田野仍留在三国故事之中。

english: The country around Xīnyí lies among the lowlands and hills north of Luòmǎ Lake. In antiquity it belonged to the territory of Zhōngwú, whose old capital stood beneath Wú Mountain. Jiànlíng County, named for a nearby mountain, was later established in the region. Rivers and low ridges distinguish this part of the plain between Xúzhōu and the coast.
simp_chinese: 新沂一带位于骆马湖以北的低地与丘陵之间。古代这里属于钟吾，旧都在峿山脚下；后来这一地区设建陵县，以附近的山名命名。河流与低矮山岭构成徐州和海岸之间的景观。

english: Xìnyí is an old town in the hills north of Gāozhōu. Founded as Xìnyì County under the Tang, it served for centuries as the seat of Dòuzhōu. The Song changed its name to Xìnyí in 976 to avoid the personal name of the emperor, and abolished Dòuzhōu in 1071, placing the county under Gāozhōu. Its old streets and county school preserve the memory of a local centre that remained under Gāozhōu through the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties.
simp_chinese: 信宜是高州以北山地中的古城。唐代设信义县，长期兼为窦州治所。宋太平兴国元年（976年）为避皇帝名讳改称信宜，熙宁四年（1071年）废窦州，县改属高州。元、明、清时期信宜仍属高州，古城街巷和县学留存了这座地方中心的历史。

english:
Xinyu lies on the Yuan River in central Jiangxi, amid a country of fields, kilns and ironworks. A Ming county gazetteer recorded more than fifty porcelain kilns and twenty-three iron workshops in the Wanli reign. The river connected their products to the Gan and the wider waterways of Jiangxi.

In the 1630s the scholar Song Yingxing served as an instructor in Xinyu. There he wrote The Exploitation of the Works of Nature, first printed in 1637. Illustrated accounts of farming, weaving, mining and other crafts brought together knowledge of the work that sustained the empire. Its attention to practical techniques made the book an unusually rich record of the skills of farmers and artisans.
simp_chinese:
新喻位于江西中部袁河沿岸，附近田野、瓷窑与铁坊并存。明代县志记载，万历年间这里有五十余座瓷窑、二十三处铁坊，袁河将物产送往赣江及江西各地。

1630年代，学者宋应星在新喻担任教谕，写成《天工开物》，于1637年初刊。书中图文并述农耕、纺织、采矿等技艺，将维系社会的劳动与知识汇集起来，留下丰富的农人和工匠技艺记录。

english: Xinzheng is associated in local tradition with Xuanyuan, the Yellow Emperor, revered as an ancestor of Chinese civilization. A shrine north of the old town commemorated his supposed birthplace, while another temple stood on Fenghou Ridge in the Juci Mountains to the southwest. The town shrine was repaired in 1570, and a magistrate erected a stele naming the site Xuanyuan's hometown in 1715. On the mountain, stone walls built along the ridges enclosed a fortified refuge of the Ming period.
simp_chinese: 新郑相传是轩辕黄帝的故里。旧城北关有祠堂纪念这位传说中的先祖，西南具茨山风后岭上也建有轩辕庙。城北祠堂于1570年修葺，1715年县令立碑，题为“轩辕故里”。风后岭上还有依山势垒筑的明代石寨墙，环绕着山顶的寨堡。

english: Xiotenko, later called Jinotega, lies in a valley of the northern Nicaraguan highlands. An indigenous town stood here before Spanish families from the Segovia region began settling nearby valleys in the late seventeenth century. Some later moved beside Jinotega, establishing a neighbourhood known as La Tejera where tiles and bricks were made. By 1710 the inhabitants had begun building a second church of lime and brick.
simp_chinese: 希奥滕科后来称为希诺特加，位于尼加拉瓜北部高地的谷地中。这里原有一座原住民城镇，十七世纪末来自塞哥维亚地区的西班牙家庭开始在附近谷地定居。后来一些人迁到希诺特加旁边，建立了制造瓦片和砖块的拉特赫拉街区。到1710年，居民已开始修建第二座石灰与砖砌教堂。

english: Xiping is an old county on the southern Henan plain. The ancient state of Bai was associated with the area west of the county town, while a county named Xiping was established in Han times. Later local gazetteers collected the lives of men admired for learning and public service, alongside the area's temples and traditions. One Qing account describes a traveller passing through Xiping and helping to repair a neglected shrine, adding a temple of the Central Peak beside it.
simp_chinese: 西平是豫南平原上的古县，汉代已置县；县城以西一带与古柏国相联系。后世县志收录了当地庙宇、传说和以学识、政绩著称的人物。一篇清代记述写到，过境西平的官员见祠宇倾颓，捐资修葺，并在旁边新建中岳庙。

english:
Xiriquitzio was a Purépecha name for the settlement that became Irapuato in the Bajío. Spanish speakers rendered it as Jiricuicho or Jiricuato. Local tradition dates the establishment of the colonial congregation of San Marcos to 1547. Parish baptismal records survive from 1633, and the settlement received the title of villa in 1826, after Mexican independence.

The later city of Irapuato lies here.
simp_chinese:
希里基齐奥是巴希奥地区后来发展为伊拉普阿托的聚落的普雷佩查语名称，西班牙人将其写作希里库伊乔或希里库阿托。地方传统将圣马尔科斯殖民聚居地的建立定于1547年。当地教区保存有1633年起的洗礼记录；墨西哥独立后，聚落于1826年获授城镇地位。

后来的伊拉普阿托即位于此地。

english: Xisa lies among the limestone hills and hollows of southeastern Yunnan. The wider district belonged to the Bazhai chieftaincy under the Ming, before passing into Qing administration. In the Kangxi reign, a market from the older settlement of Xisa was moved to nearby Dongbuna, where the new market street also took the name Xisa. The movement of the market left two places bearing the name, joined by the roads through the broken karst country.
simp_chinese: 西洒位于滇东南石灰岩丘陵与洼地之间。明代这一地区属八寨长官司，后来纳入清朝行政。康熙年间，旧西洒的集市迁至附近的董布那，新街也因此得名西洒。集市的迁移使两处地方都留下了这个名字，山间道路将它们连接起来。

english: Xisha lay east of Ningzhou in the uplands of southern Yunnan. A local leader named Xisha was remembered for building a fortified settlement here, which took his name. After the Mongol conquest, the Yuan established Xisha County, subordinate to Ningzhou; it was later absorbed into the prefecture. The Ming restored the county in 1382, only to merge it again soon afterward. Its brief administrative history preserves the name of a local chief and the settlement he built.
simp_chinese: 西沙位于宁州以东的滇南高地。相传当地首领西沙在此筑城，城镇便以他的名字命名。蒙古征服后，元朝设西沙县，隶属宁州，后来并入州中。明朝于1382年恢复县治，不久又将其裁并。这段短暂的建置历史，保存了地方首领和他所筑城寨的名字。

english:
Xiuning lies among the mountains of Huizhou, on the upper waters of the Xin'an River. North of the county seat rises Songluo Mountain, renowned for its green tea. The fragrance and careful preparation of its leaves won admirers far beyond the small area where they were grown.

During the Ming, the monk Dafang became associated with the preparation of Songluo tea. His methods and the tea's reputation spread, and writers listed it among the celebrated teas of their age. In 1608 local gentry paid for an inscription commemorating the mountain and the monk's work. Merchants carried the tea to distant markets, while its fame encouraged other producers to sell their own leaves under the Songluo name.
simp_chinese:
休宁位于徽州群山之间，新安江上游流经其地。县城北面的松萝山以绿茶闻名，茶叶香气与精细的制作技艺，使这片小小产区远近皆知。

明代僧人大方因制作松萝茶而闻名，制茶技法与茶名随之流传，文人将它列入当时的名茶。1608年，地方士绅捐资刻立《松萝山记》，纪念山与僧人的劳作。商人将茶运往远方市场，声名也使别处茶叶借用松萝之名出售。

english: Xiurong is the old name of the settlement that became Xinzhou, in a basin of northern Shanxi. Its Confucian school and temple once stood on the rise southwest of the town before the temple was moved in 1492. In 1775 the Xiurong Academy was founded on the old school site. Its teachers instructed students in the Confucian classics and literary composition, making it an important centre of learning for the prefecture.
simp_chinese: 秀容是山西北部盆地中忻州城的旧名。当地儒学和文庙原在城西南高岗，文庙于1492年迁址。1775年，秀容书院在旧学址建立，师生研习儒家经典与文章，书院成为州内重要的教育场所。

english: Xiushan lies among the hills where the lands of Sichuan, Guizhou and Hunan meet. For centuries the district was governed by hereditary local chiefs of the Yang family, under the wider authority of successive Chinese dynasties. In 1736 the Qing replaced the chiefdom with a county administration. Irrigation works such as the Jufeng weir on the Pingjiang helped bring river water to fields in the surrounding hilly country.
simp_chinese: 秀山位于川、黔、湘交界的丘陵地带。数百年间，杨氏土司在历代王朝的统辖下世袭管理当地。1736年，清廷废除土司，在秀山设县。平江上的巨丰堰等水利设施则将河水引向周围丘陵间的农田。

english: Xiuwu lies at the southern foot of the Taihang Mountains. The area was associated with the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove, third-century scholars remembered for conversation, music and a life apart from court politics. Local gazetteers identified Baijiayan in the hills with the old Shanyang dwelling of Xi Kang, one of the seven, keeping their literary and philosophical reputation alive in the landscape.
simp_chinese: 修武位于太行山南麓，与竹林七贤的故事相联系。七位三世纪名士以清谈、音乐和远离朝政的生活闻名；地方志将山中的百家岩视为嵇康山阳旧居所在，使这些文人及其思想的记忆留在山水之间。

english: Xiuyan lies among the wooded hills of eastern Liaodong, between the southern peninsula and the Yalu River. During the Ming period, its position made it a useful post for the defence of the eastern mountain country. In 1563 officials proposed placing an administrator at Xiuyan to guard against raiders threatening the coastal districts of Jinzhou, Fuzhou and Gaizhou. A surviving official seal recalls the town's role in provisioning.
simp_chinese: 岫岩位于辽东东部的森林丘陵之间，南接半岛，东近鸭绿江。明朝时期，这里的位置使它成为防守东部山地的据点。1563年，官员建议派员驻扎岫岩，防备威胁金、复、盖沿海地区的盗寇。一枚留存的官印则反映了当地管理粮饷的职责。

english: Xīxī stands beside an old salt-transport waterway in the coastal lowlands of northern Jiāngsū. Its salt warehouses drew notable officials during the Sòng, including Yàn Shū and Fàn Zhòngyān. Fàn served as supervisor of the salt store and helped organize repairs to the sea dyke, protecting fields and salt works from the tides.
simp_chinese: 西溪位于苏北沿海低地，濒临古运盐河。宋代晏殊、范仲淹等名臣曾在此任盐官。范仲淹监督盐仓，并参与组织修筑海堤，保护田地和盐场免受潮水侵袭。

english: Xixia stands among the mountains west of the Nanyang basin, at a valley entrance that gave the settlement its older name, Xixiakou. It was once the seat of Neixiang County, whose jurisdiction extended across a broad stretch of the upper Dan River region. After the county seat moved east to Zhuyang, the former seat became a town with an inspection office. That office remained in place through the Ming and Qing, marking Xixiakou's continuing role within Neixiang.
simp_chinese: 西峡位于南阳盆地西面的群山之间，地处峡口，旧称西峡口。这里曾是内乡县治，县境一度广及丹江上游地区。县治东迁渚阳后，旧县城改为镇，并设巡检司。巡检司历经明清仍存，西峡口也继续作为内乡县的一处地方重镇。

english: Xixiang lies in the upper Han River country, among the hills and valleys south of the Qinling. Tea has long been cultivated in this moist region. Early Ming records counted tea gardens in Xixiang together with those of Hanzhong, Jinzhou and neighbouring counties, and the government collected a share of the crop. Tea from southern Shaanxi entered the regulated exchange for horses in the northwestern frontier markets, linking the work of local growers to demand in the Tibetan borderlands.
simp_chinese: 西乡位于秦岭以南的汉江上游山谷。这里气候湿润，种茶历史悠久。明初记载将西乡与汉中、金州及邻县茶园一并统计，官府按茶树征收茶叶。陕南茶叶进入西北边市，用于官营茶马交换，使当地茶农的劳动与藏地对茶的需求联系起来。

english: Xiyan lies in the mountains west of Quanzhou, where old paths cross the Yuecheng range. A patrol office was established here in the early Ming, and mountain roads linked the district with the seat at Quanzhou. One route crossed the high Baoding ridge, while another passed over Damao Ridge. In 1729 the Qing replaced the patrol office with a branch administration of Quanzhou, reflecting the continuing importance of governing this mountainous country.
simp_chinese: 西延位于全州以西的山地，古道翻越越城岭，连接山中与全州城。明初这里设有巡检司；通往州城的道路有翻越宝鼎高岭的支线，也有经大帽岭的主道。1729年，清朝撤巡检司，在西延设全州分州，继续管理这片山地。

english:
Xizhou stood on the northern bank of the Huai River in southern Henan, where the plain runs toward the Dabie Mountains. It was the site of the ancient state of Xi, which Chu destroyed in 682 BC and turned into one of the first counties in China; under the Han the general Ma Yuan, who vowed to be wrapped in a horsehide on the battlefield, was marquis of Xinxi here. The district kept the name Xi through every change of dynasty.

The Jin made Xizhou a department in 1208. The Yuan briefly abolished it in 1262, restored it a year later, and in 1266 folded Xinxi County into the department; from 1293 it belonged to Runing Prefecture. In 1371 the Ming reduced the department to Xi County, placing it first under Linhao Prefecture of the Middle Capital (later Fengyang) and in 1374 under Guang Department of Runing, and in 1724 the Qing made Guang Department a prefecture directly under the province, with Xi County among its districts.
simp_chinese:
息州位于河南南部淮河北岸，平原在此向大别山延伸。这里是古息国所在，公元前682年楚国灭息，在此置县，成为中国最早的县之一；汉代立志“马革裹尸”的名将马援受封新息侯，封地就在此。历朝历代更替，“息”这个名字始终没有改变。

金泰和八年（1208年）置息州。元中统三年（1262年）一度被废，次年恢复，至元三年（1266年）新息县并入息州，至元三十年（1293年）归汝宁府。明洪武四年（1371年）降州为县，先属中都临濠府，洪武七年（1374年）改属汝宁府光州；清雍正二年（1724年），光州升为直隶州，息县属之。

english: Batán Grande, also called Sicán, lies in the La Leche valley on the northern coast of Peru. Its great adobe pyramids formed the centre of the Sicán culture, whose craftspeople produced finely worked objects of gold and other metals. Sicán flourished for centuries before its political power gave way to the neighbouring Chimú kingdom around the late fourteenth century. The monumental mounds and rich burials recall the wealth once concentrated in this valley.
simp_chinese: 巴坦格兰德又称锡坎，位于秘鲁北部海岸的拉莱切河谷。这里巨大的土坯金字塔曾是锡坎文化的中心，当地工匠制作了精美的金器和其他金属器物。锡坎繁盛了数百年，至十四世纪末前后，其政治势力为邻近的奇穆王国所取代。大型土丘和丰厚的墓葬仍诉说着这座河谷曾经集聚的财富。

english: Xochiapa lies in the Papaloapan region of southern Veracruz. Its inhabitants cultivated land away from the settlement: an account of 1831 described the local soil as unproductive and recorded that villagers traveled six to eight leagues to plant crops among the ruins of Acuezpaltepec. At that time Xochiapa was already the principal settlement of its own municipality, despite the difficulty of farming close to the village.
simp_chinese: 索奇亚帕位于韦拉克鲁斯南部的帕帕洛阿潘地区。这里的居民到远离聚落的地方耕种：一份1831年的记载称当地土地贫瘠，村民需走六至八里格，在阿奎斯帕尔特佩克遗址种植作物。尽管村庄附近耕作困难，索奇亚帕当时已是一处市镇的中心。

english:
Xochimilco lies beside the southern lakes of the Basin of Mexico. Its name, “place of the flower fields”, recalls a landscape of gardens and waterways. Farmers built chinampas, long cultivated plots raised in shallow water and separated by canals. These productive gardens supplied food and flowers, while canoes carried their produce through the waterways of the basin.

The Xochimilca settled around the lake before the Spanish conquest, extending their communities toward Tláhuac and the southern uplands. By the time the Spaniards arrived, chinampa cultivation had spread extensively across the lake. The conquest transformed the political order of the valley, but the canals and cultivated plots remained a distinctive feature of Xochimilco’s landscape. Their ordered strips of earth and water show how generations of farmers adapted the lake to intensive cultivation.
simp_chinese:
霍奇米尔科坐落在墨西哥盆地南部的湖泊旁，名字意为“花田之地”，令人想起花园与水道交织的景象。农民在浅水中筑起狭长的奇南帕耕地，以运河分隔。肥沃的田园出产粮食和花卉，独木舟则沿盆地水道运送这些产品。

西班牙征服之前，霍奇米尔科人已在湖边定居，聚落向特拉瓦克和南部高地延伸。西班牙人抵达时，奇南帕耕作已广泛分布于湖上。征服改变了谷地的政治秩序，但水道与耕地仍是霍奇米尔科景观的鲜明特征。一条条整齐相间的土地与水面，展现了世代农民如何利用湖泊进行集约耕作。

english:
Xochipillan, later called Juchipila, was a Caxcan settlement in the canyon of the river that bears its name. Hills and steep ranges rise on either side of the valley, including the mountains of Nochistlán and Morones. Its Nahuatl name recalls a place of flowers. Before Spanish conquest the settlement formed part of a country of neighboring Caxcan communities, linked by the valleys and defended heights of southern Zacatecas.

During the Mixtón War of 1541, people from Juchipila joined the resistance spreading through the region. Local leaders helped defend strongholds alongside fighters from Nochistlán and Jalpa. Spanish forces eventually brought a much larger army against the rebellion, and the rocky heights of the canyon became scenes of fierce fighting. The memory of that struggle remained closely tied to Juchipila and the neighboring peñol of Mixtón.
simp_chinese:
索奇皮兰后来称为胡奇皮拉，是位于同名河流峡谷中的卡斯坎聚落。谷地两侧耸立着丘陵与陡峭山脉，包括诺奇斯特兰和莫罗内斯山脉。其纳瓦特尔语名称使人联想到花朵。西班牙征服以前，这座聚落属于相邻卡斯坎社群的土地，各地由萨卡特卡斯南部的谷地和易守高地相连。

1541年米斯通战争期间，胡奇皮拉居民加入蔓延各地的抵抗。当地领袖与诺奇斯特兰、哈尔帕的战士共同防守据点。西班牙人最终调集规模大得多的军队镇压起义，峡谷中的岩山成为激烈战斗的场所。这场斗争的记忆与胡奇皮拉及邻近的米斯通岩山紧密相连。

english: Xochitépec, also known as Guaxícar, was an Indigenous lordship in the country of western Mexico. At the time of Spanish contact it lay near the shores of Lake Magdalena and was inhabited by the Coanos, a southern Cora people. Neighboring lordships included Etzatlán and Xalisco, amid valleys and mountains that linked the lake country with the lands of the Nayar. The lake and surrounding settlements formed part of a varied cultural landscape before Spanish conquest.
simp_chinese: 索奇特佩克又称瓜希卡尔，是墨西哥西部的一处原住民领地。西班牙人到来时，它位于马格达莱纳湖附近，由科阿诺人居住；科阿诺人是南部科拉民族的一支。邻近领地包括埃察特兰和哈利斯科，谷地与山脉将湖区同纳亚尔地区连接起来。西班牙征服之前，湖泊及周围聚落共同构成多样的地方文化景观。

english: Xojeli lies near the ancient settlement and necropolis of Mizdakhkan, on the western side of the lower Oxus. The fortified mound known as Gyaur Kala was occupied in antiquity, and the medieval city became a centre of trade and crafts in northern Khwarazm. Arab geographers mentioned Mizdakhkan in the tenth century, when a fortified citadel stood here. The burial ground and its mausoleums preserve the long religious history of the site, while the name Xojeli came into use in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 火者里位于阿姆河下游西侧，靠近古代米兹达赫坎聚落及墓地。名为高尔卡拉的设防土丘在古代便有人居住，中世纪城市则成为花剌子模北部的贸易和手工业中心。十世纪的阿拉伯地理学家提到米兹达赫坎，当时这里有一座设防城堡。墓地及其陵墓保存了此地悠久的宗教历史；火者里这个名字则在十七世纪开始使用。

english:
The Xokleng, also known as Laklãnõ, are an Indigenous people of the forests and mountains of southern Brazil. Their traditional territory extended between the high plateau and the Atlantic coast, including the valleys of Santa Catarina. Forest plants and animals sustained communities in this rugged country. The opening of roads and the expansion of cattle ranches from the eighteenth century brought outsiders into their lands.

The later city of Blumenau lies here.
simp_chinese:
肖克伦人也称拉克拉诺人，是巴西南部森林和山地的原住民族。其传统领地横跨高原与大西洋海岸之间，包括圣卡塔琳娜的河谷。森林植物和动物养育了这片崎岖土地上的社区。自十八世纪起，道路开辟与牧场扩张使外来者进入他们的土地。

后来的布卢梅瑙即位于此地。

english: The Xokó are an Indigenous people of the lower São Francisco valley, associated with the island of São Pedro and the riverbank at Caiçara. A mission dedicated to Saint Peter was established among Indigenous communities in this region. In the seventeenth century the mission’s inhabitants obtained recognition of their rights to land said to have been granted by Pedro Gomes, founder of the Porto da Folha estate.
simp_chinese: 肖科人是圣弗朗西斯科河下游的原住民族，与圣佩德罗岛及凯萨拉河岸一带有着深厚联系。殖民时期，当地原住民社区中建立了圣彼得传教聚落。十七世纪，传教聚落的居民获得了土地权利的承认；据说这片土地由波尔图达福利亚庄园的创建者佩德罗·戈梅斯赠予。

english: Lake Xolotlán, also called Lake Managua, lies in western Nicaragua beneath a chain of volcanoes. Momotombo rises beside its western shore, and the Tipitapa River connects the lake with the larger Lake Nicaragua when water levels permit. In 1524 the Spanish founded León near the lake and the volcano. Earthquakes and eruptions later threatened the settlement, which was moved away in 1610.
simp_chinese: 索洛特兰湖又称马那瓜湖，位于尼加拉瓜西部火山链下。莫莫通博火山耸立在湖泊西岸，水位允许时，蒂皮塔帕河将它与更大的尼加拉瓜湖相连。1524年，西班牙人在湖泊和火山附近建立莱昂。地震与火山喷发后来威胁这座聚落，居民于1610年将其迁走。

english: Xonuu lies at the mouth of the Moma, where that river joins the Indigirka from the right. The meeting takes place in the broad Moma–Selennyakh depression, beyond the Indigirka's passage through the mountain ranges to the south. The Moma drains a long valley between northern ridges before adding its waters to the larger river, which continues toward the lowlands and the East Siberian Sea.
simp_chinese: 霍努位于莫马河河口，莫马河在此从右岸汇入因迪吉尔卡河。交汇处坐落在宽阔的莫马—谢连尼亚赫盆地，因迪吉尔卡河已穿过南面的山脉来到这里。莫马河汇集北方山脊之间漫长河谷的流水，注入大河后继续流向低地和东西伯利亚海。

english: ǃXóõ is a name for varieties of Taa, a language spoken in the western Kalahari. Taa belongs to the Tuu family and is remarkable for its exceptionally rich range of consonants, including many click sounds. Its speakers live in a dry country of sand and scattered water, where hunting and gathering have long drawn on knowledge of animals and wild plants. Melons, roots and tubers can provide moisture when surface water is scarce.
simp_chinese: 库是塔语部分方言的名称，这门语言分布在卡拉哈里西部。塔语属于图语系，以极其丰富的辅音著称，其中包括许多搭嘴音。使用者生活在沙地和水源分散的干旱地区，长期凭借对动物及野生植物的了解狩猎采集。地表水稀少时，瓜果、根和块茎能够提供水分。

english: Xoxonal, later known as Ojojona, lies in the mountains south of Tegucigalpa. Its Nahuatl name has been interpreted as a place of greenish water. The district became associated with gold and silver mining under Spanish rule, including the mines of Guasucarán. By the late sixteenth century Ojojona formed part of the mining jurisdiction of Tegucigalpa, amid the wooded hills and valleys of central Honduras.
simp_chinese: 索索纳尔后来称为奥霍霍纳，位于特古西加尔巴以南的山区。其纳瓦特尔语名称被解释为“绿色水之地”。西班牙统治时期，该地区以金银矿业闻名，其中包括瓜苏卡兰矿。十六世纪末，奥霍霍纳成为特古西加尔巴采矿辖区的一部分，坐落在洪都拉斯中部林木覆盖的山谷之间。

english: In the southern interior of Yucatán, Xpaicheil lies in the country near Peto and Tzucacab. Both towns belonged to the Maya province of Maní before the Spanish conquest. By 1549 Peto, then recorded as Cantemoy, had been assigned in encomienda to Francisco de Berrio; its assessed tribute included 310 cotton mantles.
simp_chinese: 什派切伊尔位于尤卡坦半岛南部内陆，靠近佩托和苏卡卡夫。西班牙征服之前，这两座城镇都属于玛雅人的马尼辖区。到1549年，佩托已被分封给弗朗西斯科·德·贝里奥，当时记作坎特莫伊，其核定贡赋包括310条棉毯。

sources.title: TE A.T. 2015 Gilberto Antonio Avilez Tax.pdf

english: Xpuhil lies in the Río Bec region of southern Yucatán, amid the forests of the Maya lowlands. Its buildings display the distinctive Río Bec tradition, with tall solid towers flanking monumental façades. Several groups of structures spread across the settlement, suggesting a community organised around more than one noble house. Xpuhil flourished especially towards the end of the Classic period, when this regional style reached its mature form.
simp_chinese: 什普希尔位于尤卡坦南部里奥贝克地区的玛雅低地森林中。建筑呈现独特的里奥贝克传统，纪念性立面两侧耸立着高大的实心塔。数组建筑散布在聚落中，显示社群可能由不止一个贵族家族组织。什普希尔在古典末期尤其兴盛，当时这一地区风格已发展成熟。

english: The Bears Paw Mountains form an isolated arc of high ground between the Missouri and Milk rivers. Streams including Beaver, Clear and Peoples creeks descend from the range toward the Milk. Long before the present valleys took shape, an ice sheet diverted the ancestral Missouri south of the mountains; east of the range, the Milk River now follows part of the older valley.
simp_chinese: 熊掌山脉在密苏里河与米尔克河之间形成一片孤立的弧形高地。海狸溪、克利尔溪和皮普尔斯溪等河流从山中流向米尔克河。在这些河谷形成之前，冰盖曾迫使古密苏里河改道至山脉以南；山脉以东，米尔克河流经旧河谷的一部分。

english: In the rugged country of the Cumberland Mountains, wooded ridges and narrow valleys surround the place later known as Norton. High Knob rises nearby, the highest summit of the range. Late in the eighteenth century, settlers made their homes in these mountains: William Prince built a house in the area in 1787. The settlement that grew there was known as Prince's Flats before taking the name Norton.
simp_chinese: 在坎伯兰山脉崎岖的山地中，林木覆盖的山岭和狭谷环绕着后来称为诺顿的地方。不远处的高丘是整个山脉的最高峰。十八世纪末，移民开始在这些山地安家：威廉·普林斯于1787年在附近建起一座房屋。此后发展起来的聚落曾称为普林斯平地，后来才改名诺顿。

english:
Xuancheng lies in southeastern Anhui, among the valleys and hills of Jiangnan. In 1166 the Southern Song elevated Xuanzhou to Ningguo Prefecture, with its seat at Xuancheng. The prefecture included several counties, among them Jing County to the southwest.

The region was known for paper and brushes used in writing and painting. Paper was made in several counties of old Xuanzhou, with Jing County especially associated with the craft. Ming writers praised paper made there; its connection with Xuancheng lay in the wider prefectural region rather than a claim that all Xuan paper was made in the city itself.
simp_chinese:
宣城位于安徽东南部，地处江南的丘陵与河谷之间。南宋乾道二年（1166年），宣州升为宁国府，府治设在宣城县；所属诸县包括西南面的泾县。

宣城地区以书画所用的纸、笔闻名。旧宣州多个属县都有造纸传统，其中泾县尤其以制纸著称。明代文人称赞泾县纸，其与宣城的联系属于更广的府域历史，并不意味着所有宣纸都在府城内制造。

english:
Xuande belongs to the northern frontier country around Wanquan, where basins and hills connect the agricultural interior with routes beyond the plain. A historical Xuande County existed in this wider area and was abolished in 1371. Roads and passes linked cultivated districts with travellers and troops, while climate and access to water shaped local work.

During the medieval and early modern centuries, the wider northern approaches experienced changing authority among Chinese dynasties, Mongol powers, and local societies. Under the Ming, fortified places, garrisons, military households, and defensive walls sought to secure routes near the capital's western and northern approaches. Trade and diplomacy continued across the frontier alongside warfare. Qing rule later transformed these relationships by linking the region with a larger Inner Asian imperial framework. Local markets and agricultural labor remained essential beneath new arrangements. Xuande's regional history therefore reflects the interaction of defense, commerce, and rural production, showing how frontier institutions depended on the practical work of communities managing fields, animals, and roads within an environment whose political importance often exceeded its immediate economic resources.
simp_chinese:
宣德属于万全一带的北方边地，盆地与丘陵连接农业内地和通向平原之外的道路。历史上的宣德县位于这一广大地区，1371年被撤销。道路和山口将耕作区与旅人、军队联系起来，气候和水源则影响居民的生产。

中世纪及近代早期，广大北方入口经历中国王朝、蒙古势力和地方社会之间权威变化。明朝通过堡垒、驻军、军户及防御墙体，试图保障都城西北入口附近道路。贸易外交与战争同时存在于边疆。清朝后来将地区纳入更大内亚帝国框架，改变这些关系。地方市场和农业劳动在新安排下仍不可缺少。宣德的区域历史因此体现防御、商业及农村生产互动，边疆机构依赖居民管理田地、牲畜和道路的实际劳动；环境政治重要性常超过附近经济资源，也使国家需求与社群生活持续紧密相连。

english: Xuanhua lay northwest of Yibin, in the country beside the Min River. Once a county under Xuzhou, it later survived as a market town on the river plain. An old gazetteer records a mountain south of the county where local people gathered for communal rites, drinking and celebration. The town and its neighbouring villages stood between the waterways of the basin and the hills to the west.
simp_chinese: 宣化位于宜宾西北的岷江一带，曾是叙州辖县，后来以场镇延续于河边平地。旧志记载县南有夷牢山，当地人在此举行社祭，饮酒欢聚。市镇和周围村落坐落在盆地水道与西方丘陵之间。

english: Xuanhua was the county attached to the city of Nanning on the Yong River. Its seat stood south of the river before being moved to the northern bank under the Song. The county remained the seat of Nanning under the Yuan, Ming and Qing, while the river brought merchants and boat communities into contact with its markets. A Ming gazetteer recorded the trade in salt, betel nut, silk and cloth in Xuanhua.
simp_chinese: 宣化是邕江畔南宁城的附郭县。县治原在江南，宋代迁至北岸，元、明、清时期仍为南宁的治所。江路将商人与舟居人群带到当地市场；明代方志记载，宣化的交易包括盐、槟榔、丝与布。

english: Xuanning was a county northwest of Datong, on the edge of the grasslands beyond the northern frontier. It belonged to Datong under the Yuan and was abandoned as a county in the early Ming, when a military garrison was established in the district. Under the Qing, the wider country became pasture for Chahar Mongol banners, while imperial horse-breeding grounds lay towards the cultivated south.
simp_chinese: 宣宁是大同西北的旧县，地处北方边境外的草原边缘。元代宣宁县属大同路，明初废县，在这一带设置卫所。清代广大地区成为察哈尔蒙古诸旗牧地，靠近南方民田处则设有太仆寺牧厂。

english: Xuanping was a fortified settlement on the western line of the Xuanfu frontier. Its origins reach back to the Jin and Yuan, and under the Ming it formed part of the network of walled posts administered by the Wanquan garrison. Soldiers stationed in such forts guarded roads across the uplands and supported the walls and watchtowers that protected the approaches to Beijing.
simp_chinese: 宣平是宣府西路的堡寨，其历史可追溯至金元时期。明代宣平堡属万全右卫，是边防线上众多城堡之一。驻军守护高地道路，与城墙和烽燧相互配合，保卫通往北京的门户。

english: Xucheng was the county town and administrative centre of Dongping in western Shandong. Its earlier seat had been abandoned after a breach of the Yellow River in 1000, and the site of that older city was eventually submerged beneath Dongping Lake. Under the Yuan, Xucheng served as the seat of Dongping Circuit. The early Ming reduced Dongping to a department in 1374 and abolished Xucheng County, incorporating its territory into the department directly.
simp_chinese: 须城是鲁西东平的县城和地方治所。公元1000年黄河决口后，县治从旧址迁出，旧城后来淹没于东平湖中。元代，须城是东平路的治所；明初于1374年将东平降为州，又撤销须城县，把其辖地直接并入东平州。

english: Xuěshān rises to 3,886 metres in northern Taiwan, the highest summit of the range that bears its name. Ridges radiate from the peak, dividing the headwaters of rivers that descend through deep mountain valleys. Atayal communities have given the mountain several names. One, Sekoan, refers to fissures in its rocky cliffs; another, Bbu Hagay, recalls the stones scattered around the summit. Its slopes and neighbouring ridges formed part of the hunting grounds of the mountain peoples.
simp_chinese: 雪山耸立于台湾北部，海拔3886米，是雪山山脉最高峰。山脊从主峰向四周伸展，分隔流入深谷的河流源头。泰雅人对这座山有多个名称：Sekoan 指岩壁上的裂沟，Bbu Hagay 则与山顶周围散布的石块有关。山坡与邻近岭脊曾是山地居民的猎场。

english: Snow mountains rise above the valleys north of Lijiang, their summits overlooking the great bend of the Jinsha River. Haba and Yulong stand on opposite sides of the river, which cuts the deep Tiger Leaping Gorge between them. Forested slopes give way to alpine meadows and snow at higher elevations. These great ridges divide the highlands around Zhongdian from the valleys farther south and form a striking landmark above the river.
simp_chinese: 丽江以北雪山高耸，俯瞰金沙江大拐弯附近的河谷。哈巴雪山与玉龙雪山隔江相对，江水在两山之间切出深邃的虎跳峡。林木覆盖的山坡向上渐变为高山草甸与积雪。群山分隔中甸高地和南方河谷，也是江上醒目的地标。

english:
Xugou belongs to the Taiyuan basin of central Shanxi, where cultivated plains and surrounding mountain routes support a productive inland economy. Grain, livestock, gardens, and household crafts supply communities connected through markets and roads. Water management and the condition of soils influence agriculture, while passes link the basin with other parts of northern China. The combination of local production and strategic access gives settlements value beyond their immediate fields.

Xugou became a county under the Jin dynasty and belonged to Taiyuan prefecture under the Ming and Qing. In 1763 Qingyuan county was absorbed into Xugou. Across the wider Taiyuan region, agriculture and commerce supported local communities, while Shanxi merchant networks connected the basin with distant markets. Warfare and dynastic transition could disrupt life and production, but county government and village institutions also gave local affairs a lasting framework.
simp_chinese:
徐沟属于山西中部太原盆地，耕作平原和周围山间道路支持丰产内陆经济。粮食、牲畜、园圃及家庭手艺，供应通过市场道路相连的社群。治水和土壤条件影响农业，山口把盆地同华北其他地方连接起来。地方生产与战略入口结合，使聚落价值超出附近田地，居民也借此参与更广运输、行政和商业网络。

徐沟在金代设县，明清时期隶属太原府。乾隆二十八年（1763年），清源县并入徐沟。太原地区的农业和商业支持地方社群，山西商人的网络也将盆地与远方市场联系起来。战争和王朝更替可能扰乱生活与生产，但县级行政和村落组织也为地方事务提供了延续的框架。

english: Xuguit lies where the grasslands of Hulunbuir meet the wooded slopes of the Greater Khingan. Its name has been explained in Mongolian as a place of extensive forest. Rivers descend from the mountains towards the Hailar and the Argun, linking the forested uplands with the open steppe. In the eighteenth century a Qing postal station stood on the route between Qiqihar and Hulunbuir, near the river country associated with this place.
simp_chinese: 苏吉位于呼伦贝尔草原与大兴安岭森林山坡交接处。这里的喜桂图之名被解释为蒙古语中大片森林的意思。河流从山地流向海拉尔河与额尔古纳河，将林地高原与开阔草原相连。十八世纪，清朝在齐齐哈尔通往呼伦贝尔的路线沿途设驿，靠近这一带的河流地区。

english:
The Xukuru inhabit the Serra do Ororubá in the uplands of Pernambuco. Amid the dry country of the agreste, the mountain has wetter areas with woodland, springs and productive soils. These resources have supported Indigenous communities whose history is closely tied to the slopes and settlements of Ororubá.

In the seventeenth century missionaries established an Indigenous village at Ararobá, bringing together Xukuru and other peoples of the region. The village served as a centre of catechesis for the peoples of the area. The settlement later became known as Cimbres and was raised to the status of a town in 1762. Colonial settlement and cattle raising brought increasing pressure on Indigenous land, but the Xukuru retained ties to the mountain and its places through successive changes in authority.
simp_chinese:
舒库鲁人居住在伯南布哥高地的奥罗鲁巴山。周围的阿格雷斯特地带较为干燥，山上却有湿润地区、林地、泉水和肥沃土壤。这些资源养育了原住民社区，其历史与奥罗鲁巴的山坡和聚落紧密相连。

十七世纪，传教士在阿拉罗巴建立原住民村落，将舒库鲁人与当地其他民族聚集起来。这一村落成为当地各民族接受传教的中心。该聚落后来称为辛布里斯，1762年升为城镇。殖民定居和养牛使原住民土地受到越来越大的压力，但在统治多次变化的过程中，舒库鲁人仍维系着与山地及其各处地方的联系。

english:
The Jumano, also recorded as Xumana, traveled and traded across the lands between the Rio Grande and the plains of Texas. Their connections reached La Junta de los Ríos, where farming villages stood at the meeting of the Rio Grande and the Río Conchos. Spanish writers used their name for people encountered across a broad region, including traders who visited distant communities.

In 1683 the Jumano leader Juan Sabeata traveled to El Paso to request missionaries and military help for his people and their allies. Franciscans subsequently established missions at La Junta. Sabeata also led trading expeditions linking the river junction with communities in Chihuahua and central and eastern Texas. These journeys show the reach of Jumano diplomacy and exchange across the northern frontier of New Spain.
simp_chinese:
胡马诺人也曾被记作舒马纳，他们在格兰德河与得克萨斯平原之间往来贸易。其联系延伸至拉洪塔德洛斯里奥斯，那里有农耕村庄坐落于格兰德河与孔乔河交汇处。西班牙作者在广大地区遇到的人群中使用过胡马诺这一名称，其中包括前往远方社群的商人。

1683年，胡马诺首领胡安·萨贝亚塔前往埃尔帕索，为自己的族人与盟友请求传教士和军事援助。方济各会随后在拉洪塔建立传教站。萨贝亚塔还率领贸易队，将两河交汇处与奇瓦瓦、得克萨斯中东部的社群联系起来。这些旅程显示了胡马诺外交和交换网络在新西班牙北方边疆的广度。

english: The ǃXun, or ǃKung, are among the San peoples of the Kalahari and the country to its west. Different groups use the names ǃXun and Ju, both words for people. Hunting and gathering have long been part of their way of life. In the Nyae Nyae country, Juǀʼhoan communities gathered mangetti nuts and other plants, dug roots for water, and hunted game with bows and poisoned arrows. Healing dances brought the community together, sometimes continuing through the night.
simp_chinese: 勋人又称昆人，是卡拉哈里及其西部地区的桑人族群之一。不同群体自称勋或朱，两者都有“人”的意思。狩猎和采集长期是他们生活的一部分。在尼艾尼艾地区，朱霍安人采集曼盖蒂坚果和其他植物，挖掘含水的根茎，并用弓和毒箭猎取野兽。疗愈舞蹈使社群聚在一起，有时会持续整夜。

english:
Xunaa Kwaan belongs to the Tlingit world of southeastern Alaska, where islands, deep channels, forests, and mountain shores provide a rich maritime environment. Salmon, marine mammals, shellfish, plants, and land animals support livelihoods organized through seasonal work and careful preservation. Canoes connect communities along waterways that can be more practical than overland routes. Knowledge of tides, weather, and productive places is inseparable from social relationships and responsibilities to particular territories.

Huna Lingít oral history remembers Glacier Bay as an ancestral homeland. Around 1700, an advancing glacier overran settlements there, and clans dispersed to places including Icy Strait and northern Chichagof Island; they later settled at Xunniyaa, or Hoonah. Tlingit communities maintained clan identities and ceremonial obligations, and coastal trade connected them with neighboring peoples. Russian and other foreign ventures brought new goods and demands during the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, entering an already active Indigenous maritime world.
simp_chinese:
胡纳宽属于阿拉斯加东南特林吉特世界，岛屿、深水通道、森林和山岸构成丰富海洋环境。鲑鱼、海兽、贝类、植物及陆地动物，支持通过季节劳动和细致保存组织的生计。独木舟沿常比陆路更实际的水道连接社群。潮汐、天气和丰产地点知识，与社会关系及特定领地责任不可分割，资源也具有明确文化政治意义。

胡纳特林吉特人的口述历史将冰川湾记作祖先的家园。约1700年，前进的冰川吞没了当地聚落，氏族分散到冰海峡和奇恰戈夫岛北部等地，后来定居于胡纳。特林吉特社群维系氏族认同和仪式义务，沿海贸易也将他们与邻近居民联系起来。十八世纪和十九世纪初，俄罗斯及其他外来者带来新货物和需求，进入的已是一个活跃的原住民海洋世界。

english:
Xunantunich is a Maya site overlooking the Mopan River in western Belize. Its monumental center is dominated by the pyramid known as El Castillo, whose upper walls bear elaborate stucco decoration. The city grew especially during the Late Classic period, when its plazas and buildings rose above a landscape of neighboring settlements. Though royal power declined near the end of that era, evidence of later domestic occupation shows that activity in the area did not cease at once.

The later city of Belmopan lies here.
simp_chinese:
修南图尼奇是伯利兹西部一处俯瞰莫潘河的玛雅遗址。宏伟的中心区以名为“城堡”的金字塔为主，其上层墙面饰有精美的灰泥浮雕。这座城市在古典期晚期尤其兴盛，广场和建筑耸立于周围聚落之上。尽管王权在这一时期末衰落，后来的居住遗迹表明，该地区的活动并未立刻停止。

后来的贝尔墨潘即位于此地。

english: Xundabé was an Indigenous settlement or district in the mountains of western Antioquia, associated with the Catío peoples. The country around Urrao lies between the Cauca and Atrato basins, with steep slopes and forested valleys. Spanish expeditions entered these mountains in the sixteenth century, encountering communities whose cultivation, fishing and use of forest resources drew on different elevations of the rugged landscape.
simp_chinese: 顺达贝是安蒂奥基亚西部山地的原住民聚落或地区，与卡蒂奥民族有关。乌劳周围位于考卡河与阿特拉托河流域之间，分布着陡坡和森林谷地。十六世纪，西班牙远征队进入这些山地，遇见当地社群；人们利用崎岖地貌的不同海拔，耕作、捕鱼并采集森林资源。

english: Xungake is the country of an Udihe group associated with the Khungari River. The river rises on the western slopes of the Sikhote-Alin and runs through forested valleys to the Amur. Like other Udihe territorial names, Xungake connects a people with the river along which they lived. The Khungari receives many mountain tributaries before spreading into a network of channels near its meeting with the great river.
simp_chinese: 逊克是与洪加里河有关的一个乌德盖人群体的居地。洪加里河发源于锡霍特山脉西坡，穿过森林谷地流入黑龙江。与其他乌德盖地方群体的名称一样，逊克之名将人群与其居住的河流联系起来。洪加里河接纳许多山间支流，在汇入大江前分成多条水道。

english: The Xun, also called the Sun Bira, runs east through the hills south of the Amur and joins that river near its middle course. Its tributaries drain the forested Lesser Khingan. Oroqen communities along the rivers of this country used local names for themselves, including Bilarchen. Under Qing administration hunters who remained in the mountains supplied sable pelts as tribute, while others were enrolled for service in the Buteha banners.
simp_chinese: 逊河又称逊毕拉河，向东流过黑龙江以南丘陵，汇入黑龙江中游。它的支流汇集小兴安岭林地的水。沿江鄂伦春社群以居地自称，其中包括毕拉千。清代留居山林的猎人承担贡貂差役，另有部分人编入布特哈旗服役。

english: The Sukpay descends from the Sikhote-Alin and joins the Khor, one of the great tributaries of the Ussuri. The Chui and Kabuli also drain the wooded mountains into the Khor basin. From these uplands the Khor runs west to the Ussuri, carrying water from a broad network of mountain streams.
simp_chinese: 苏克派河发源于锡霍特山脉，汇入乌苏里江的一条大支流霍尔河。楚伊河和卡布利河也从林木覆盖的山地流向霍尔河流域。霍尔河再由高地向西流入乌苏里江，汇集众多山溪的水流。

english: Xun County stands beside the Wei River, overlooked by the isolated height of Dapi Mountain. The mountain’s great stone Buddha drew worshippers, while the river carried traffic past the county town. In 1499 the young scholar Wang Yangming came here escorting an official’s coffin and stayed to teach and write. A wooden bridge across the Wei was built in 1508 and rebuilt in stone in 1565.
simp_chinese: 浚县位于卫河畔，大伾山独立于平原之上。山上的大石佛吸引信众，河道则承载往来船只。1499年前后，青年王阳明护送官员灵柩至此，停留讲学并写下诗文。1508年卫河上建起木桥，1565年改建为石桥。

english:
Xúnyáng stands where the Xún River meets the Han in the mountain country of southern Shaanxi, on a bend so tightly curved that the town is called the Taiji city, after the yin-yang symbol. The Qin set a pass at the river mouth and a county called Xúnyáng; the Eastern Han abolished it, and the Western Jin restored it in 283. After the Yuan left it vacant, the Ming set up the county again in 1370, under Xìng'ān Zhōu.

Downstream, Shǔhé town grew at another confluence on the Han. In the Qianlong reign the governor Bì Yuán described it as a crowded place where goods passed between boats and land transport; a road from there followed the Shu River toward the provincial capital. Boats carried timber, lacquer, tung oil and medicinal herbs toward Hankou, and merchants from Huguang built guild halls on the quay. Its riverside trade linked the county to the wider Han valley.
simp_chinese:
旬阳位于陕西南部山地，旬河在此汇入汉江，河道弯曲，城区形似太极图，因而有“太极城”之称。秦朝在旬水入汉水处设旬关和旬阳县；东汉并入西城县，西晋太康四年（283年）复置。元代县废，明洪武三年（1370年）重置，属兴安州。

下游的蜀河镇坐落于另一处汇流口。清乾隆年间，巡抚毕沅称这里商客云集、水陆货物交卸，并有道路沿蜀河通往省城。船只把木材、生漆、桐油和药材运往汉口，湖广商人则在码头上兴建会馆。江上贸易使旬阳与更广阔的汉江流域相连。

english: Xùpǔ lies beside the Xù River in the mountains of western Hunan. The place is closely associated with the exiled poet Qū Yuán, whose poem “Crossing the River” mentions his wandering at Xùpǔ. Later writers travelled here to recall his journey. The Ming thinker Wáng Yángmíng wrote of mooring at the mouth of the river, with clouds around the post station above him. Under the Ming and Qing, the county belonged to Chénzhōu Prefecture, sharing in the literary traditions of the Yuán River valley.
simp_chinese: 溆浦位于湖南西部山地的溆水之滨，与流放诗人屈原的故事关系密切。《涉江》写到诗人在溆浦徘徊，后世文人也来到此地追忆他的行迹。明代思想家王阳明曾写诗记述泊舟溆浦江口，云中可见驿楼。明清时期，溆浦属辰州府，是沅水流域文化的一部分。

english: Xuru Lake lies in the high country of southern Changtang, among the ranges and basins north of the Yarlung Tsangpo valley. The Tibetan plateau contains many lakes without outlets to the sea, enclosed by mountain ridges and expanses of cold grazing land. Snow peaks rise above the basins, while severe winters and a short summer shape the surrounding plateau.
simp_chinese: 旭如错位于羌塘南部高地，雅鲁藏布江谷地以北的山岭与盆地之间。青藏高原有许多没有入海出口的湖泊，四周环绕山脊和寒冷牧地。雪峰高出盆地，漫长严冬和短暂夏季塑造了周围的高原景观。

english: Xutsnoowü Kwáan is the homeland of the Hutsnuwu Tlingit on Admiralty Island. Around Kootznahoo Inlet, their principal settlements included Angoon and nearby Killisnoo Island. A Tlingit account tells how Deisheetaan hunters followed a beaver from the inlet to a beach on Chatham Strait and chose the site for a house. By the late eighteenth century, Russian and English fur traders were visiting the area.
simp_chinese: 胡茨努乌宽是海军上将岛上胡茨努乌特林吉特人的家园。库茨纳胡湾周围的主要聚落包括安贡和附近的基利斯努岛。特林吉特人的记述讲述，德谢坦猎人跟随一只海狸，从海湾走到查塔姆海峡的沙滩，并选定此处建屋。十八世纪末，俄国和英国毛皮商人来到这一地区。

english:
Xúwén stands at the southern end of the Léizhōu Peninsula, across the strait from Hainan. Its ancient harbour was one of the points from which Han ships sailed towards Southeast and South Asia, carrying gold and silk to exchange for pearls, glass and other treasures. The coast and the passage to Hainan continued to give the district a strategic importance long after the Han.

The county seat moved several times. It was transferred to Bīnpǔ in 1291, then to Hǎi'ān during the Ming, before returning to Bīnpǔ in 1501, when a stone wall was built. Hǎi'ān had its own fortified military post, founded in 1394 and repaired under both Ming and Qing rule. Its harbour was a crossing point for officials, merchants and other travellers bound for Hainan.
simp_chinese:
徐闻位于雷州半岛南端，与海南隔海相望。汉代船只从徐闻古港等地出发，驶往东南亚和南亚，以黄金、丝织品交换珍珠、琉璃和其他珍物。此后漫长的岁月中，海岸与通往海南的渡口仍使徐闻具有重要地位。

徐闻县治几经迁徙：1291年迁至宾朴，明代又迁海安，弘治十四年（1501年）回到宾朴并筑石城。海安另有守御所城，建于1394年，明清均曾修葺。其港口是官员、商人和其他旅客渡往海南的要津。

english: Xūyí stands near the lower Huái River, where low hills overlook the waters of Hóngzé Lake. Across the river lay the old city of Sìzhōu and the ancestral tombs of the Míng imperial family. Work on the tombs began in 1385, but in 1680 floods on the Yellow and Huái rivers submerged both the city and the burial site.
simp_chinese: 盱眙位于淮河下游附近，低丘俯瞰洪泽湖水。河对岸曾有泗州城和明朝皇室的祖陵。祖陵始建于1385年；1680年黄河、淮河洪水并涨，泗州城与陵寝一同被淹没。

english:
Xúzhōu occupies a meeting place of routes on the great plain between northern and southern China, where the Sì and Yí rivers once flowed near its walls. From 1128 the Yellow River had taken over the Huái bed, so that the city sat on a vital but flood-prone stretch of waterway. In August 1351 the Red Turban leader Lǐ Èr, called Sesame Lǐ, seized the city; in 1352 the Yuán chancellor Tuōtuō retook it and massacred its people, and Xúzhōu was demoted from route to the lesser Wǔ'ān Prefecture. Under the Míng it was a directly governed prefecture, and the Qīng raised it to a full prefecture in 1733.

In 1624 the Yellow River broke its banks nearby and flooded Xúzhōu. Water filled the city and destroyed the walls built in the early Míng. Repeated floods left layers of silt over the older streets, while the need to keep grain boats moving on the Grand Canal drove successive attempts to control the river.
simp_chinese:
徐州位于中国南北之间的大平原，是交通要地，泗水、沂水曾流经城旁。自1128年起黄河夺淮，使徐州成为一处重要而易受水患威胁的水路节点。1351年八月，红巾军首领芝麻李攻占徐州；次年元朝丞相脱脱收复此城并屠城，徐州路被降为武安州。明代徐州是直隶州，清代在1733年升为徐州府。

1624年，黄河在徐州附近决口，洪水淹没徐州，冲毁明初所建城墙。接连的水灾在旧城上留下层层淤泥，而保障漕运的需要，也促使历代官员不断治理河道与运河。

english: Xylokastro lies on the southern shore of the Gulf of Corinth, near the mouth of the Trikalitikos River. Its name means a wooden castle, recalling a timber fortification associated with the medieval defence of the coast. Inland rises Mount Kyllini, or Ziria, while pine trees grow along the shore. The coastal strip faces the mountains across the gulf and provides a route between Corinth and the western Peloponnese.
simp_chinese: 克西洛卡斯特罗位于科林斯湾南岸，靠近特里卡利蒂科斯河口。它的名字意为“木城堡”，让人想起中世纪保卫海岸的木制工事。内陆的基利尼山又称齐里亚山，海岸边则生长着松林。狭长的滨海地带面向海湾对岸的群山，也是科林斯与伯罗奔尼撒西部之间的通道。

english: Y'lkytvèèm is a river flowing between the hills of southern Chukotka toward the Gulf of Anadyr. Its Chukchi name has been interpreted as a river of hard snow, a reminder of the severe winter conditions of this coast. Sockeye salmon enter the river to spawn, and the surrounding tundra provides seasonal grazing for reindeer herders moving through the country inland from the Bering Sea.
simp_chinese: 伊尔基特维姆河流经楚科奇南部群丘之间，流向阿纳德尔湾。它的楚科奇语名称被解释为坚雪之河，令人想起这片海岸严酷的冬季。红鲑进入河流产卵，周围苔原则为在白令海内陆迁徙的驯鹿牧民提供季节性牧场。

english: The Iguaçu lowlands lie west of Guanabara Bay, crossed by rivers that descend from the Serra do Mar. The Jacutinga people inhabited this country before colonial estates spread through the river basin. Santo Antônio da Aldeia dos Jacutingas preserved the name of their community in the parish church. As routes between Rio de Janeiro and the interior developed, river landings and roads became important to the surrounding settlements.
simp_chinese: 伊瓜苏低地位于瓜纳巴拉湾西侧，发源于海岸山脉的河流穿过其间。殖民庄园扩展到流域之前，雅库廷加人居住在这里。雅库廷加村圣安东尼奥堂区教堂保留了他们社区的名字。随着里约热内卢与内陆之间的道路发展，河岸码头和道路对周围聚落日益重要。

english: Ya'kti'ki lies among the Rocky Mountain valleys near the upper Brazeau River. The river drains the mountains eastward and eventually joins the North Saskatchewan, which carries its waters onto the plains. High ridges, snowfields and glacial valleys divide this watershed from the Athabasca basin to the west. The Southesk is another mountain stream that joins the Brazeau drainage.
simp_chinese: 亚克蒂基位于落基山谷地，靠近布拉索河上游。河流汇集山区水源向东流，最终注入北萨斯喀彻温河，河水随后进入平原。高山脊、雪原与冰川谷地将这一流域同西方阿萨巴斯卡河流域分开；索瑟斯克河也是流入布拉索河水系的山间河流。

english: Yáttaish recalls the Yatasi, a Caddoan people whose villages lay along the Red River in northwestern Louisiana. They were neighbours of the Natchitoches and other Caddo communities, in a country of river bottoms and wooded uplands. In 1686 the French traveller Henri de Tonti visited Yatasi settlements on the Red River. Warfare and disease later reduced their numbers, and Yatasi people joined other Caddo communities near the French trading post at Natchitoches.
simp_chinese: 亚塔伊什使人想起亚塔西人，这一卡多语族人群的村庄位于路易斯安那西北部红河沿岸。他们与纳基托什人及其他卡多社群为邻，生活在河流低地和林木高地相间的地区。1686年，法国旅行者亨利·德·通蒂到访红河沿岸的亚塔西聚落。后来战争和疾病使其人口减少，亚塔西人与其他卡多社群一同迁到纳基托什法国商站附近。

english:
Yaakwdáat lies beside Yakutat Bay on the Gulf of Alaska, beneath the ice and mountains of the Saint Elias range. Eyak, Ahtna and Tlingit ancestors came to this coast in different generations, forming the communities known as the Yakutat Tlingit. They fished the rivers and hunted seals in the icy waters of the bay, where families maintained seasonal camps as well as winter villages.

Russian traders began a fortified post here in 1795, seeking valuable sea otter pelts. Relations deteriorated as the newcomers interfered with local fishing and committed other abuses. In 1805 Yakutat warriors attacked and destroyed the post, ending the Russian settlement. The struggle was one of several clashes as Russian traders attempted to establish themselves along the Tlingit coast.
simp_chinese:
亚克达特位于阿拉斯加湾的雅库塔特湾畔，圣埃利亚斯山脉的群峰与冰川耸立在后方。埃雅克人、阿特纳人和特林吉特人的祖先先后来到这片海岸，形成了被称为雅库塔特特林吉特人的社群。他们在河流中捕鱼，在海湾冰冷的水域猎取海豹，除越冬村庄外，还设有季节性营地。

1795年，俄国商人在此建立据点，寻求海獭皮贸易。随着外来者干扰当地渔场并施加其他侵害，双方关系日益恶化。1805年，雅库塔特战士进攻并摧毁据点，结束了俄国人在此的定居。这场冲突是俄国商人试图在特林吉特海岸立足时遭遇的一系列争斗之一。

english:
Yaanga was a Tongva village near the Los Angeles River, in a basin where river, foothills and coast lay within reach of its people. A great sycamore later called El Aliso stood at the village and served as a gathering place and landmark. Traders and visitors came to a community that formed part of a network of Tongva villages across southern California.

In 1769 the Portolà expedition encountered Yaanga, whose residents offered the visitors food and shell beads. The Spanish founded the pueblo of Los Angeles nearby in 1781, bringing new demands for labour and conversion. Yaangavit worked at the growing pueblo and at missions, while floods and colonial policies displaced the community. In 1836 officials ordered another move, placing the village on ground vulnerable to flooding.
simp_chinese:
扬加是洛杉矶河附近的通瓦村落，居民可以利用盆地河流、山麓与海岸的物产。村中有一棵后来称为埃尔阿利索的大悬铃木，既是聚会处，也是醒目的地标。商人和访客来到这里，而村落本身属于南加利福尼亚通瓦村落的广泛网络。

1769年，波托拉远征队来到扬加，居民向访客提供食物与贝珠。1781年，西班牙人在附近建立洛杉矶镇，带来劳动与改宗的新要求。扬加人在不断扩张的市镇和传教站劳作，洪水和殖民政策也迫使社群迁移。1836年，当局再次下令搬迁，将村落安置在易受洪水侵袭的地方。

english: The Yaaucanigá were a group of the Abipón, a Guaycuruan-speaking people of the Gran Chaco. Their name was associated with water, distinguishing them from other Abipón groups of the forests and open plains. The Abipón adopted horses and ranged widely across the lowlands. In the eighteenth century Jesuit missionaries established settlements among Abipón communities on the colonial frontier, recording their distinct groups and leaders.
simp_chinese: 亚奥卡尼加是阿比蓬人的一个群体。阿比蓬人是大查科使用瓜伊库鲁语族语言的民族；亚奥卡尼加的名称与水有关，用以区别森林和开阔平原上的其他群体。阿比蓬人使用马匹，在广阔低地活动。十八世纪，耶稣会士在殖民边疆为阿比蓬社群建立聚落，并记载其不同群体与首领。

english: Yabrin is an oasis at the northern edge of the Empty Quarter, surrounded by the sands of the Arabian interior. Wells and natural groundwater sustain its palm groves, making it a place of cultivation amid an immense desert. Travellers approaching from the al-Ahsa oasis or the coast had to cross long stretches between watering places. Yabrin's position made it a landmark on routes towards the southern sands and the oases beyond them.
simp_chinese: 耶卜林是空旷之地北缘的一处绿洲，四周环绕着阿拉伯内陆的沙海。水井和天然地下水滋养椰枣林，使广阔荒漠中出现耕作之地。从哈萨绿洲或海岸前来的旅人必须穿越水源点之间的漫长路程。耶卜林的位置使它成为通向南方沙漠和更远处绿洲的道路上的地标。

english: Yabro is a recorded form of Jaburu, a name associated with the Kalamaia people of Western Australia's inland country. Kalamaia country extends across parts of the Wheatbelt and Goldfields. The name Jaburu means north, while Jawan was used for a northwestern section of the people beyond Mukinbudin.
