sources.title: 2013 Annual Report of the Sustainable Tourism Observatory of Xidi-Hongcun Hongcun (Chinese-English) (Data 2012 and H1 2013).pdf

english:
Yìxiàn lies in the valleys at the foot of the Taihang Mountains, on the Yi River from which the town took its name. The Yuan governed Yizhou under Baoding Circuit, and in the Ming the county was merged into the department, which belonged to Baoding Prefecture. The Zijing Pass, one of the three inner passes of the Great Wall, stood in the mountains of the upper Juma River, in the district, and in 1449 the Oirat army of Esen came through it on its way to Beijing.

The Qing made the town an imperial necropolis. The Yongzheng emperor rejected an earlier site and chose Taiping Valley near Yizhou for his tomb. Work on the Tailing began in 1730, and the Western Qing Tombs grew up beneath the wooded slopes, with stone gateways, bridges and halls laid out along a ceremonial approach. In 1733 Yizhou was raised to a directly administered department, with Laishui County from Baoding and Guangchang County from Shanxi transferred to it, to manage the burial ground.
simp_chinese:
易县位于太行山东麓的山谷，因易水得名。元代易州隶保定路，明代易县省入州，州属保定府。拒马河上游的山地中有紫荆关，是长城内三关之一；1449年，也先率领的瓦剌军队由此入关，兵临北京。

清朝将这里选作皇家陵区。雍正皇帝放弃原先选定的陵址，改选易州太平峪为陵地，泰陵于1730年动工，清西陵由此在林木覆盖的山麓间建成，石牌坊、桥梁和殿宇沿神道依次排开。1733年，为管理陵区，易州升为直隶州，原属保定府的涞水县和山西的广昌县划归易州。

english:
Yixing, west of Lake Tai, became known for tea and pottery. Under the Ming, a government tea station checked certificates and taxed tea from the district and its neighbours. Changing habits of tea preparation in the sixteenth century encouraged local potters to make teapots from distinctive clay.

Unglazed Yixing wares became prized in the late Ming, with makers such as Shi Dabin celebrated for their work. The products travelled far beyond the county: in the seventeenth century Dutch and English trading companies carried them to Europe, where they inspired imitations.
simp_chinese:
太湖以西的宜兴以茶与陶器闻名。明代官府在此设茶叶验税机构，查验凭证并对本地及邻近地区的茶叶征税。十六世纪饮茶方式的变化，促使当地陶工用特色泥料制作茶壶。

宜兴无釉陶器在明末受到珍视，时大彬等制作者因其作品而闻名。产品远销县境之外：十七世纪荷兰和英国商贸公司将其运往欧洲，并引发当地仿制。

english: Yixing lay in the mountain country north of the Great Wall, on the approaches between Gubeikou and the grasslands. Under the Jin, the former town of Baitan was raised to Yixing County in 1203, within the territory of Xingzhou. The county continued under the Yuan, when the region belonged to the circuit of Shangdu. Its old town guarded a valley route through the northern hills.
simp_chinese: 宜兴位于长城以北山地，处在古北口通往草原的道路附近。金朝于1203年将白檀镇升为宜兴县，属兴州。元代宜兴仍为县，所在地区归上都路管辖。旧城坐落在北方山岭间的谷道上。

english: Yiyang lies on the Luo River west of Luoyang. Further upstream at Hancheng are the remains of an ancient city associated with the state of Han. The county was called Shou'an under the Tang, but the Yuan restored the name Yiyang and absorbed neighbouring Fuchang. Early in the Ming, officials and local residents undertook to rebuild the county's damaged Confucian school, contributing money and grain to restore its gates and hall after years of warfare.
simp_chinese: 宜阳位于洛阳以西的洛河畔，上游韩城一带留有战国韩国的古城遗迹。唐代此地称寿安，元代恢复宜阳之名，并将邻近的福昌并入。明初，地方官与士民捐俸出粟，修复战乱中受损的县学，重建庙门和大成殿。

english:
Yiyang stands beside the Zi River, where the waters of western Hunan flow toward Lake Dongting. Its name has endured through many changes in the territory administered from the town. In the Song, part of its mountain hinterland was separated to form the counties of Xinhua and Anhua.

Under the Ming and Qing, Yiyang belonged to Changsha Prefecture. The Zi carried the dark tea of Anhua downstream to Yiyang, tying the town to the tea markets of the interior. Farther upriver, specialist tea towns and merchants developed along both banks, with the river providing the means to carry their goods out of the mountains.
simp_chinese:
益阳坐落在资江边，江水从湘西山地流向洞庭湖。尽管县域历经变迁，益阳之名长期沿用。宋代曾从其山地腹地划出部分区域，设立新化、安化二县。

明清时期，益阳属长沙府。安化黑茶沿资江顺流而下，到达益阳，再进入内陆各地的茶叶市场。上游两岸兴起专营茶叶的市镇与茶行，资江舟船则把山中的茶运往外地。

english:
Yiyang lies on the Xin River in northeastern Jiangxi. Its name became known far beyond the county through a vigorous style of theatre that grew from southern drama and local speech. Yiyang singing was marked by high, forceful melodies and a performance in which one voice could be answered by others.

By the early Ming the style had spread across Jiangxi and into other provinces. As travelling companies adapted it to local languages and music, related forms appeared in Anhui, Zhejiang and elsewhere. These styles came to be known collectively as high-pitched singing, or gaoqiang. Their stories included the Buddhist tale of Mulian rescuing his mother, performed over many scenes for audiences at temples and festivals.
simp_chinese:
弋阳位于赣东北信江沿岸。南戏与当地语言相结合，形成富有力量的弋阳腔，使县名远播四方。其曲调高亢，演唱时常有一人开腔、众人帮唱的形式。

明初，弋阳腔已传遍江西并流向外省。戏班将其与各地语言、音乐结合，在安徽、浙江等地衍生出不同声腔，后来统称高腔。剧目中有佛教的目连救母故事，演员在庙会和节庆中连演多场，供观众欣赏。

english: Yiyang is a historic name in the hill country south of Luoyang, associated with the Yi River and the lands of Songzhou. The earlier Yiyang County was raised to a prefecture during the Song–Jin wars, and under the Jin the prefecture became known as Songzhou. In 1476 the Ming established a new Yiyang County from parts of Song County and neighbouring districts. Its gazetteer links the creation of the county to the settlement and registration of displaced households in the surrounding region.
simp_chinese: 伊阳是洛阳以南山地的古地名，与伊河及嵩州一带的历史相连。宋金战争期间，早先的伊阳县升为州，金代改称嵩州。1476年，明朝从嵩县及邻近地区划地，新设伊阳县。县志将这次建县与安置、登记周边地区的流民联系在一起。

english: Yiyuan is the hill country around the sources of the Yi River in central Shandong. One branch descends from the slopes southwest of Mount Lu, while another rises near Laosong Mountain; the waters meet before flowing southeast toward Yishui. Under the Yuan, Ming and Qing, the surrounding lands were divided among Yishui, Mengyin and Linqu. Villages and fields occupied the lower valleys, with wooded ridges and mountain streams between them.
simp_chinese: 沂源是山东中部沂河发源的山地。一支源流出自鲁山西南山坡，另一支发源于老松山附近，汇合后向东南流往沂水。元、明、清时期，这片地区分属沂水、蒙阴和临朐。村落与田地坐落在较低的谷地中，山岭、林木和溪流横亘其间。

english: Yízhāng sits on the southern slope of Qítián Ridge in the middle Nánlǐng Mountains, on the Húnán side of the border with Guǎngdōng. It began in 617, in the last years of the Suí, as Yìzhāng County, cut from Chēnxiàn. In 976 its first character was changed to Yí to avoid the personal name of Emperor Tàizōng of the Sòng, Zhào Guāngyì, and the county kept the name Yízhāng through the Yuán, Míng and Qīng, a part of the mountain country of Chēnzhōu.
simp_chinese: 宜章位于南岭山脉中段骑田岭南麓，在湖南与广东交界的湖南一侧。617年，隋朝末年，朝廷自郴县析置义章县。976年，为避宋太宗赵光义之讳，县名首字改为“宜”，此后元、明、清三代一直沿用，属群山环绕的郴州一带。

english: Yizhou lies in western Liaoning near the Daling River. Its ancient town, known as Yizhou under the Liao, preserves the great Buddhist temple of Fengguosi. Founded in 1020, the temple's vast main hall contains a group of painted clay Buddhas. Inscriptions record repairs under the Jin, Yuan, Ming and Qing, showing how successive generations maintained this remarkable monument of Liao architecture.
simp_chinese: 义州位于辽西大凌河附近，辽代称宜州。古城内的奉国寺是一座规模宏大的佛教寺院，创建于1020年，大雄殿中供奉着彩塑佛像。金、元、明、清各代的重修碑记显示，历代居民持续维护着这座珍贵的辽代建筑。

english: Yizhou was an old fortified centre west of the Liao River, associated with a Liao imperial princess and the households under her authority. Its site at Tayingzi preserves a Liao pagoda, a reminder of the Buddhist patronage of the families who held power here. A road ran east from Yizhou toward Kaiyuan, passing through other old towns. It remained an important route in Yuan and Ming times, with stations serving travelers along the way.
simp_chinese: 懿州是辽河以西的古老城镇，辽代曾属于一位皇族公主及其属户。塔营子城址留有辽塔，见证了当地权贵家族对佛教的信奉。一条道路从懿州向东通往开原，沿途经过其他旧城。元明时期，这条路仍是重要的东西交通线，沿途驿站为来往行旅提供服务。
